articleTitle: The automatic book page turner for disabled individuals
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Reading books, magazines, and printed materials is an essential activity of daily living. Turning pages of a book or magazine is often cumbersome for avid readers and disabled individuals. An automatic page turner can serve as an assistive technology for people with disabilities and people with limited upper-body extremity function. A page turner can provide avid readers with convenient book support and page turning features. The purpose of the research is try to find a better new form of a automatic page turner that will help such disabled people to complete the motions of turning pages so that to satisfy the desire of reading and learning.

articleTitle: A comparative study of tactile paving design standards in different countries
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Tactile paving is a system of textured ground surface indicators found on public environments to assist blind and visually impaired persons to distinguish locations and directions and identify potential hazardous and then to move and reach expected destinations. The design of tactile paving is different from those of many public facilities because tactile paving is mainly used by the blind or visually impaired persons. Although tactile paving has been invented for several decades and now is commonly implemented in many cities, criticism on its unsatisfactory design for its particular users as well as other people still frequently heard. One of the critical comments is the lack of a good standard for tactile paving. This paper first reviews the history and development of the tactile paving. By reviewing particular characteristics of tactile paving and needs of blind and visually impaired people, this paper discusses the importance of standard for tactile paving. This paper then compares different tactile paving design standards in several selected countries. Focusing on the factors of type, form and colour in constituting the standards of tactile paving, this paper tries to identify the problems of tactile paving in China, and then gives some suggestions and insights for consideration and further investigation.

articleTitle: Digital game ontology: Semantic web approach on enhancing game studies
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper is a report focus on the development of digital game ontology as a knowledge framework. At the end of this paper, we suggest the direction of further development and use of this ontology as a core component for developing the future Web applications of games.

articleTitle: Design of paper cutter machine
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Existent paper cutter machine was of low degree in automation and behindhand in product line of honeycomb paper processing, so structure analysis and pneumatic control technology of a new device had been introduced based on simulation technique. First, three-dimensional software PRO/E was used for avoiding the overlap and penetration phenomenon before the model was imported to MSC.Adams, where the working process of paper cutter machine was simulated, to optimize the structure and mode of motion. Its pneumatic and electric loop had been designed in the software of FluidSlM to improve working efficiency and automation. Then, paper cutting process had been analyzed by FEA software of MSC.Dytran to guarantee the quality of fracture face. Now, paper cutter machine had been manufactured which was effectively controlled and used.

articleTitle: A study on impact factors of the distance eases between body and garment
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The manikin, wearing garments with various sizes and various material mechanical properties, was scanned using 3D body scanner. Based on the clouds data of the body and garments, the program was compiled to extract the distance eases between the body and garment from different cross sections. The changing rule of the distance eases with the changes of the body angles was analyzed. It was found that the distance eases were changed irregularly with the increase of garment sizes and the uniform changing of material mechanical properties or the body angles. The distance eases were influenced by the ease allowance and the material mechanical properties. There was an internal relation between the distance eases and material mechanical properties. This research is useful in a further investigating the fit of the garments and it provides testing standard for 3D simulation of fashion design.

articleTitle: Parameters calculation and structure design of pipe belt conveyer
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Pipe belt conveyor is a new type of special belt conveyor and it is wildly used in conveying powder material. In the paper, the advantages of pipe belt conveyor are introduced. Calculation of pipe belt conveyor’s main parameters is different from that of conventional belt conveyor’s. The parameters such as throughput, belt speed, belt width, resistance, tension in belt and power are described. The length of transition section is analyzed because it is important to the belt life. Hexagon supporting rollers and tipping device are necessary parts of pipe belt conveyor. The structures of them are also discussed.

articleTitle: The using of mind map in concept design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Mind mapping is a technique which applies whole brain thinking to substitute one¿s traditional thinking mode. Through the path of framing the subject to diverge human thinking, and connecting the 2nd/3rd level to the 1st/2nd level branches, mind mapping can achieve its target as a method of specifying radial thinking. Conceptual design is the summary of designers¿ organizing and refining their emotional and sudden thinking. Utilizing mind mapping appropriately in conceptual design could help us keeping the balance of sciences and arts, as well as of logical and imaginary thinking, so that designers¿ potential could be fully developed. The product of conceptual design is designers¿ ultimate pursuing, and the creativity in designing procedure is their high-way of thinking. Application of mind mapping could concentrate and enforce human intellectual in conceptual design.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of Render Farm Manager based on OpenPBS
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the extensive use of the 3D computer graphics technology, the computation and the processing data are rapidly increased . Computer animation rendering is a long time process. In this paper, the animation rendering implementation based on OpenPBS is proposed. The OpenPBS-based animation rendering application provides the uniform rendering job management. Render Farm Manager is designed to provide OpenPBS a rendering module interface to manage the rendering job, and to propose GOS Portal a rendering job xml template for animators to submit the rendering job. Two Animation models are experimented and tested to show the efficiency of the OpenPBS-based animation rendering application.

articleTitle: Development research of cultural creative industry based on the intangible cultural heritage in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper starts from an investigation on the intangible cultural heritage and cultural creative industry in Hangzhou. Based on some research and analysis of the investigation results, this paper associates intangible cultural heritage with cultural creative industry and puts forward that cultural creative industry will be one of the best opportunities for intangible cultural heritage and the latter will promote the development of the former, thus forming a unique cultural creative industry chain of Hangzhou. This paper also gives some planning schemes and concrete design ideas on two categories: folk literature and traditional handicrafts. We hope that intangible cultural heritage will be popular in our daily lives and become a necessary part of our cultural lives, and thus it can be well protected and inherited.

articleTitle: Computer-aided kinematical modeling of parallel mechanism with redundant Inputs
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the kinematical impact factor concept, this paper makes a thorough research about the velocity and acceleration of all the components of PSS-type parallel mechanism. The universal expressions about the first and the second order inverse impact factor matrixes of PSS-type parallel mechanism are deduced, which is applicable to any parallel mechanism with the PSS limbs random configured. An example of the parallel mechanism with redundant inputs is brought forward and analyzed to show the validity of this method.

articleTitle: Design and actualization of SOA-based data mining system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Combining SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture) and the latest trend in date mining system development, this paper explores the advantages of service-based Data Mining services and a framework for designing the data mining system based on SOA, and also a way to set up this framework by the use of WCF (Windows Communication Foundation) is brought forward. The detailed analysis into key technologies necessary for achieving this framework is made particularly in this paper. These key technologies includes the implementation methods of the following services, that are uploading big documents service, data cleaning service, data Mining algorithm service, OLAP (OnLine Analysis Processing) service, date management service based on metadata, the realization of data warehouse service and OLAP service through programming with ADOMD.NET and how to make the solution of designing Data Mining system by using WCF .

articleTitle: Research on 3D complex surface construction and NC machining based on MasterCAM
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Automation level of complex surface NC program is the key to the companies. As NC manufacturing technology moves forward rapidly, the NC program depending on CAD/CAM becomes more critical. MasterCAM is one of the most commonly used CAD/CAM softwares worldwide and has some comprehensive surface milling functions with a simplified, customizable interface, and abundant powerful, fast toolpath. Based on MasterCAM, the NC technology characters and CAD/CAM NC machining process are introduced. According to the basic surface frame, the construction methods of loft surface and coons surface are deeply studied by examples, the construction conditions of complex surfaces are researched, the construction skills in 3D complex surfaces are represented. A 3D craft model is built by MasterCAM, machining technology is planned, proper process methods, tool type, toolpaths and technology parameters are selected. The workpiece is well machined by NC method, and the NC code is automatically obtained at last. The machining process is correct by analyzing the computer simulation. Complex surface construction and NC program are deeply studied.

articleTitle: Research on the industrial design method of control panel based on man-machine engineering restriction
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on ergonomics and the basic requirements of control panel design, this paper studied the computer-aided design method based on man-machine principle restraint with control panel modeling, color and other man-machine elements being chosen as research subjects. The study realized the restraint design from the product structure to size, ameliorated the human machine interactive relationship from the aspect of human physiological and psychological demands and improved the comprehensive quality of control panel.

articleTitle: Experience design of the theme restaurant make the dining be a memorable experience
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The ¿experience design¿ is a new mentality and method for modern urban development, the massively appearance of theme restaurants has proven the formidable vitality of experience design. How to utilize the principle of experience design becomes the question which is focused on by both the designers and the managers of restaurant. It will bring more creativity, more wonderful enchantingly, and will promote the experience value of the restaurant.

articleTitle: Research on humanization design based on product details
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The newly emerged product techniques gain increasing popularity among products design. Despite the large number of techniques already implemented in commercial systems to develop the quality and production, these techniques still lack in providing specific and emotional design for consumers. Then how to make your products different from the others and embody the humanization caring in the background of industrial production? In this work, we first address this issue through analysis the importance of concerning with product details. Then, we introduce the concept of the stages and methods of product detail design, which incorporates specific details, such as color, construction, ergonomics, handling, craft or the location of the buttons. Some product models with good details will be shown in the article. Finally, we conclude that right and perfect details can be the shining stars of a product and embody the humanization design. It also provides designers with the methods of detail design proved to be very promising.

articleTitle: Simulation to design car interior trims based on NVH performance
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The simulation method to design car interior trims based on NVH performance is introduced in this paper. An SEA (statistical energy analysis) model with all the parameters was built based on a domestic car. The inputs of interior noise were got by the combination method of roads testing and other simulations. The sound pressure levels in the engine bay and at driver¿s ear in some running conditions were measured. And the inputs to auto-body from engine mounts were also measured. The aerodynamic pressure and suspensions inputs to panels in high speed were simulated. The accuracy of this model was validated by the results of software. Then, the simulation expressed that the interior high noise of a car can be reduced by adding the sound insulation and absorption in interior trims design. The research of this paper covered all the effects of aerodynamics, engine inputs and the suspensions inputs together. The interior trims design is very significant to improve the NVH (noise vibration & harshness) performance using SEA simulation. And the research of this paper can be used to direct the application of trims materials in car interior trims design.

articleTitle: Magnet circuit optimization design of giant magnetostrictive actuator
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To optimize the electromagnetic performance of giant magnetostrictive actuator(GMA), equivalent magnet circuit equation was proposed, and effects of magnetic circuit components, gap¿s magnetic permeability and the evenness of driving magnetic field on the magnetic field characteristics were analyzed based on the equation. the driving coil¿s structure was designed, and its shape was optimized based on G-factor; with the electromagnetic field analysis function available in ANSYS program, several different magnetic circuits and their field distribution are analyzed. As a result, a kind of magnetic circuit structure with more even magnetic field is found out. The actuator prototype was made and tested, and result shows the optimal method proposed in the paper can greatly improve performance of GMA.

articleTitle: Emotional interaction in product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In the process of using products, customers get acquainted with the features and properties of products through interacting with them, and become emotionally involved at the same time. Thus, great importance should be attached to emotional interaction in product design, i.e. products should be able to interact emotionally with users besides displaying themselves. This paper analyzes the emotional issues in the process of interaction from the perspective of interaction design, such as personal relevance, cultural conceptions and the realization of self-worth, etc. and studies the design philosophy of emotional interaction from three levels-reactive, behavioral and reflective, more specifically, utilizing the perceptual senses to achieve reactive interaction; employing the cognition and experience in the process of using products to attain behavioral interaction; designing meaningful form which encourages the user to evaluate, associate and reflect to accomplish reflective interaction.

articleTitle: Research on pedestrian evacuation simulation based on fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Pedestrian evacuation simulation has many important applications. For example, based on the pedestrian evacuation simulation results one can predict the evacuation time and evaluate the performances of pedestrian facilities. This paper derives a mathematical model for the pedestrian evacuation based on fuzzy logic. In this fuzzy model for the pedestrian evacuation, each pedestrian¿s behavior is linguistically depicted by some simple qualitative physical and psychological laws. These qualitative laws are then transformed into a quantitative mathematical model using a fuzzy modeling approach. The evacuation simulation results based on the proposed fuzzy model are consistent with the observed phenomena for the pedestrian evacuation. Moreover, the simulations show that the parameters involved in the proposed fuzzy model have prominent influences on the evacuation time and dynamical features of pedestrian evacuation.

articleTitle: A survey of cloth simulation and applications
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Cloth simulation involves a combination of a large range of techniques, such as mechanical simulation, numerical integration, collision detection, constraints, and rendering techniques for creating garments. In this paper, we present major cloth simulation techniques and central application fields, for instance, garment CAD/CAM, game engine, E-commerce, computer films and fashion shows. Furthermore, based on the proposed techniques, several successful productions of cloth simulation are introduced, which provide guidelines of virtual cloth and outline directions of future research.

articleTitle: Product visual image design based on product family DNA
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: As a crucial part in building brand image of an enterprise, product visual image design is an effective way to communicate and extend brand connotation. Based on continuity and mutation of the product image system, this paper discusses the concept of product family design DNA and studies the system construction of product family design DNA under product visual image. Taking Nokia Mobile design as an example, it explores how to reflect product visual image design by building the design DNA of product family. The results show that orderly product image innovation is a power to promote brand image construction and to perfect and deepen brand image. The establishment of the entire product image in a company is the result of mutual influence of brand concept and various innovative image factors.

articleTitle: Human vibration characteristic and experiment research on man-machine system in dynamic environment
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: According to the design and analysis needs of man-machine interface in mechanical system in dynamic environment, a 4-DOF vertical vibration model of the human upper body of man-machine system is set up based on multi-body dynamics. The kinetic parameters of this model are obtained by the method of parameter identification and optimization theory (equivalent mass, equivalent stiffness and equivalent damping). The human vibration characteristics from both time and frequency domains are analyzed and obtained according to the 4-DOF model and the transfer function. A biological structure model of seated human is constructed using LifeMOD software, and then it is introduced into ADAMS/Vibration module and the dynamic vibration environment is simulated, and the frequency response characteristic of displacement, velocity and acceleration in different parts of human body are analyzed. The simulation results and the computation results agree well with each other. The experimental research on human vibration was performed on the SA30-S802/ST random vibration table, and the varying trend of the ratio of the acceleration responses to a 0.05 g acceleration excitation was obtained. The coincidence between the experimental and computed results validates the correctness and rationality of constructed human model. The above research provides a scientific basis for the design and analysis of man-machine interface in mechanical system in dynamic environment.

articleTitle: The harmonics of kansei images
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Delivering the right product experience, which is a user’s reflection of a combination of functionality, usage, cost and appearance, is a key factor for product acquisition and commercial success. Establishing and representing the relation between a product’s shape and the perceived aesthetic sensibility it elicits on a person (kansei), is a key factor in the design of tools to support designers in delivering the right product’s appearance. This paper presents an approach to mathematically represent a product’s kansei based on the frequency signature (harmonics) of a shape. This mathematical representation should allow the automatic indexing and retrieval of images from a repository of design precedents. This is done through a series of experiments aiming at determining the relation between images, kansei words and the frequency signatures of those images. Tests suggest the method is promising and can be used for indexing images in Content Based Image Retrieval Systems.

articleTitle: Emotional design of web page
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The design of Web page should be Internet-user-oriented. The key factor of a successful Web page design lies in that the designer can find out counterparts of products in the real world. Another important factor of a successful-designed web page is that the designer can represent the products by a combination of harmonious and inducing colors, images and characters. The pluralistic society nowadays brings about individual aesthetic need. A unique and individualized emotional design of a web page can impress Internet users deeply, initiate Internet users to click promptly and contribute to the establishment of social image and mutual communication service via a website. This thesis mainly deals with color emotion, image emotion and character sign emotion in Web page design. Through a typical example of a Web page design in a Web site, the aesthetics and application of visual signs of a web page is discussed. The emotional design of colors, images, and character signs of a web page are studied.

articleTitle: Computer recognition algorithm for density uniformity of clothing fabric
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper proposes a new computer recognition algorithm which can analyze density uniformity of clothing fabric easily and correctly based on Difference Value Matrix Model (DVMM). Firstly, the clothing fabric image must be pretreated to make it more distinct. Secondly, the clothing fabric image is divided into some segments according to precision demand and a matrix of point’s position is built. Thirdly, the weft difference value matrix and the warp difference value matrix are constructed by calculating the difference value between a point and near point. Fourthly, we present Offset Mean Value Formula (OMVF) to analyze density uniformity of clothing fabric for every segment. Fifthly, considering all segments’ weft and warp difference value matrix, a changing curve for density uniformity of fabric is depicted. Finally, an example proves that above method is effective for detecting density uniformity of clothing fabric.

articleTitle: The consistency of product design and brand image
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Through the analysis of consumers, products and brand image, this paper intercept product design and brand image, analysis brand image by understanding consumer motivation, product design processes and brand development, summarize design methods suitable for brand products, so as to provide some inspiration and ideas for product design study.

articleTitle: Use of design psychology in the product design —consumer psychology on the role of design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the development of society. The product design was no longer confined to functionalism which only satisfies person’s physiological needs. It requests not only to satisfy the material, but also to satisfy the psychological feeling. In the past, People’s shopping idea is take durable, inexpensive as a criterion, and now, more and more people pay great attention to the psychological value displayed by the good product modeling design, Including manifests its social position, the cultural standard, Individual interest and so on.If the design is a creative activity combined by the art, the science, the rationality and the perception. The design psychology is something provides strength of science and the rational for this activity, The design work obtains the success depending on the excavation of the object’s thought and the sentiment. Then, it had decided it is insufficient only depends on the knowledge of esthetics, it principle for the designer through using the design psychology. Only improve understanding and take advantage of the characteristic of consumer’s psychological demand, and grasp the psychology of “designed objective”, can we design the work successful.

articleTitle: Research on Tibet Tangka based on shape grammar
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Introduce a new research method which based on shape grammar for depth analysis of art of Tibetan Tangka paintings. As an important components of painting art of Tibet, although Tangka paintings is an extensive research subject, the studies are often confined to the age investigation, religious significance and coloring of Tangka paintings, there are few ones from the perspective of drawing methods, thickness, length and crookedness of the lines. In fact, all these are also the important elements of Tangka paintings. This paper proposes a new research direction which based on shape grammar. There are some general characters and rules in their modeling elements, which make it possible for the shape grammar to be applied in our study. Our research emphasis on the modeling rules of the Buddha Tangka paintings. And try to discover the aesthetic standards of Tibet culture in a relatively objective way, and find out its guiding role for present design.

articleTitle: Research on users’ product color perception of automobile
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Color plays an important role in product design and affects consumers’ preference in purchase. To study the user’s color perception, a novel approach of the semantic differential (SD) method was adopted to examine the difference of color perception between plane (2D-form) and product (3D-form). Taken the automobile color design as an example, the difference of users’ color perception and color cognition were explored, the mapping model of users’ color perception of product was set up so as to improve color design of product rationality and validity. The study of the users’ color perception of product will assist the designers in color design of product, and to find out the color attributes and meaning for color design of product.

articleTitle: Study on injection process and mould design for electric fan shell
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In injection process, many factors affect the molding process and the final quality of the parts. The method of traditional mould design is relied on the designer’s experience, and it can be time-consuming and expensive. With the help of CAE systems, designers can reduce costly trial-and-error loops and shorten development cycle, and correctly solve production problems on material property, product design, and mould design. The paper introduced the application of MoldFlow in injection molding development of the electric fan shell. Best injection location is attained. Fill time, weld lines, air trips, clamp force, pressure at end of fill, and pressure at injection location are deeply studied. The numerical simulation corresponds well with practical process. The simulation provides scientific and valuable injection process information and helps engineers to take right decisions when they develop the tools. At last, the die for electric fan shell is designed, and the CNC machining of the die core is programmed by UG NX software.

articleTitle: Research and design of an executable modeling language based on MOF
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The ultimate aim of software development is to produce executable code, which is the most core of the model application at the same time. Currently various models which are built by kinds of modeling technologies can not be executed. And all of these attribute to non-execution of modeling language itself. This paper studies the function of MOF in the modeling language field and behavior abstract model of OCL, and on this foundation I design a sort of modeling language named XKL that described by text. The rationale of its design of structure metamodel comes from the basic structure of EMOF, at the same time the design of its behavior metamodel comes from the expression abstract syntax model of OCL. In this way, not only XKL conforms to the MOF standard in the modeling structure, but also embodies the ability of the OCL language in the aspect of describing model constraint. So the models which are built by the XKLbased modeling tool are executable.

articleTitle: Pattern recognition based on fuzzy cluster for recognizing garment style in the photo
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: It is an important work to extract a garment style from garment photo, which can get much valuable information to guide manufacture and design for enterprises. But this research is so difficult that no one can study it successfully so far. This paper proposes a set of computer recognition method based on cluster pattern recognition and silhouette knot points detecting. Firstly, garment photos are analyzed using “line by line scanning” and “8-points connecting” ways and built a pattern silhouette, and then the silhouette is classified to certain garment style using cluster pattern recognition. Secondly, the data structure of silhouette is established. The garment silhouette is expressed by ring data structure and line-line data structure. Thirdly, the garment silhouette is divided into different dress pieces using fuzzy cluster recognition theory, and each separated dress pieces is recognized. Finally, an example prove that this method is effective for unfold garment in the photo.

articleTitle: The research on emotional design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, designers are keeping more attention to the emotional experience when people use the product. In this article, the authors focus on innovation of product design which is based on human¿s emotional demand. First, the authors have studied the theory of Norman¿s emotional design and the situation awareness theory of cognitive psychology, and then indicate that the basic attribute of product has been changed and the designing elements have been extended further. Finally the authors consider that the method of scenario design is fit for emotional design. Emotional design still takes user-centered concept as its philosophy.

articleTitle: Adaptive reconstruction of T-Spline surfaces of arbitrary topological type
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, we present an automatic procedure for reconstructing a smooth parametric surfaces using T-Splines from a triangulation mesh .A key ingredient in our solution is a scheme for automatically constructing both T-mesh and a parameterization of the data points over T-mesh. We use the discrete conformal parameterization presented in [9]as the solution of choice for mapping the 3D surface to a 2D domain, then using quad-tree subdivision in 2D domain to automatically constructing the T-mesh that we need for the reconstructing. By using least square approximation we can get the control point of the surface and finish our algorithm until the result is satisfactory. We use adaptive refinement of the T-mesh in order to satisfy user-specified error tolerances and demonstrate our method on real data.

articleTitle: A kind of method for selection of optimum threshold for segmentation of digital color plane image
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A threshold for binary processing of a digital color plane image can be determined by a means of integrating a minimum threshold value with a Laplace histogram, which has, as an example, carried on a confirmation for processing a digital color plane image of a conveying stone to be crushed under monitoring. Results indicate that this computational method is of operating easy, saving computing time and without transforming a color image to gradation one for a threshold processing. It can be used in a selection of threshold and an automatic selection of a segmenting threshold for a digital color plane image.

articleTitle: The prototyping in Interaction Design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper gave an overview of the developing interdisciplinary of Interaction Design, and its relationship with other academic fields. The paper then discussed the methods, tools, basic principles and values of building interactive prototypes, which have become the core of the whole Interaction Design process. With a perspective of prototyping research in Interaction Design, the purpose of the paper is to broaden the depth and width of design as an academic field. Unlike the Human Computer Interaction (HCI) study in computer science, the paper is more inclined to closely relate to daily life and interaction Construction of the prototyping, with a focus on technology integration in the everyday life, rather than technology itself. To provide an effective design methods and ideas create useful for interactive products that would elegant and rich humanistic.

articleTitle: Virtual design and kinematic simulation for cutter of corn harvester
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The 3D model of vertical shaft spindle cutter of corn harvester is established by UG software and the mechanical dynamic software ADAMS is used to establish the 3D kinematic simulation model of the vertical shaft spindle cutter. Kinematic simulation for spindle cutter and cutting off corn stalk is accomplished with ADAMS. The simulation results demonstrate that the movement of blades in initial stages is instable and the variable number of the blades has no obvious effect on the state of motion of the vertical shaft spindle cutter. However, with the increasing number of blades, the force on pin shaft of blade imposed by the blades and the force on rotation pin imposed by knife plate are reducing.The force of cutting off corn stalk is true and credible.

articleTitle: The study on intelligent technology integrating Ergonomics into industrial design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In view of the industrial design process involving many Ergonomics knowledge, this paper has carried out the study of the technology integrating Ergonomics into industrial design. The purpose is to reduce the tedious inquire about Ergonomics knowledge and ensure the efficiency of industrial design on the premise of that is free to innovative design. And based on PRO / Engineering powerful 3D modeling features and good performance of the re-development, an Intelligent Design System Integrating Ergonomics into Industrial Design (IDS-IEID) has been achieved. In addition to providing essential knowledge help and anthropometry data query, the system has intelligently implemented Ergonomics design and Ergonomics checking-evaluation on chairs, tables and other instruments commonly used in industrial design. Users will be permitted to log-in(out) with freedom between the platforms of PRO/E, Ergonomics and industrial design Finally, for work-chair as an example, the feasibility of the system has been verified.

articleTitle: Study on Web Mining Algorithm based on Usage Mining
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Web usage mining is an application of data mining technology to mining the data of the web server log file. It can discover the browsing patterns of user and some kind of correlations between the web pages. Web usage mining provides the support for the web site design, providing personalization server and other business making decision, etc. Web mining applies the data mining, the artificial intelligence and the chart technology and so on to the web data and traces users’ visiting characteristics, and then extracts the users’ using pattern. This article will study on Web Mining Algorithm based on Usage Mining. And it also produces the design mentality of the electronic commerce website application algorithm. This algorithm is simple, effective and easy to realize, it is suitable to the web usage mining demand of construct a low cost B2C website.

articleTitle: Research of the recruiting qualifications of the ID profession and their implication in ID education
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to make the college education of industrial design meet the need of society development in China, this article presents a survey study that searches for the various job titles currently adopted in industrial design profession in China and their corresponding demanded competencies. Job opportunities available in the industrial design profession announced in four major job searching Web sites collected during January 2008 to Aug 2008. Content analysis was conducted to analyze the recruiting qualifications required by jobs. Overall, 200 jobs tiles are categorized into 4 groups : industrial design, mechanism design, interface design, and others. The recruiting qualifications are classified into basic requirements and required competency. The survy results indicate that the competence of creative thinking and the ability of computer-aided design are highly demanded. Information about industrial design recruiting not only enables students to better understand the job market, but also helps design educators to consider how to develop the design education programs to enhance students¿ competencies to adopting this competitive society.

articleTitle: Application study of data mining on customer relationship management in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the establishing of the idea that enterprises center on customers and development of the network technology, building an effective CRM system will be very important. CRM through data mining can get more efficiency in acquiring new customers, increasing value of existing customers and retaining good customers. At the same time, the data of data warehouse will offer the best data resource for the application of data mining on CRM. Firstly, the paper introduces CRM and customer value, analyzes the important effect of customer and customer relationship management on enterprises, then introduces the architecture of CRM based on data mining, discusses the main steps of designing the data warehouse, and describes the meaning of data mining applied to CRM. At last, the promoting effects of data mining to individual service are presented.

articleTitle: Design of wine packaging container based on the reverse engineering
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Wine packaging container needs innovative design. The main appeal points of wine packaging container design were discussed. Explored the innovative ways of wine packaging container design and established the innovative design system of wine packaging container were proposed. Improving design on wine packaging container on the basis of reference for bottle design of foreign wines, high-grade perfume and other things shape by using of reverse engineering and computer technique, industrial design methods and principles. The application example of reverse design of wine packaging container was given.

articleTitle: FEM simulation and study on rectangular drawing process with flange
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Drawing process is important in manufacturing area. The development of tooling for rectangular drawing can be time-consuming and expensive, for the drawing process is very sensitive to some processing parameters, such as blank holder force, lubrication condition and layout of draw bead. Numerical simulation of the drawing process is a powerful tool for reducing costly trial-and-error loops and shortening development cycle. The finite element method (FEM) can simulate the stress-strain and thickness changes of the sheet, and predict the forming defects such as cracking, wrinkling, and thinning. As an example, numerical simulation of the rectangular drawing process is presented in the paper. A 3D finite element model of the drawing process is developed by the commercial FEM software, DYNAFORM, which is based on dynamic-explicit FEM procedure, LS-DYNA. The geometrical surfaces of tooling and sheet are modeled in CAD software, UG NX. The plastic stress-strain characteristics of the sheet are based on uniaxial tensile test. Simulation results show the distribution of stress, strain, and thickness. Based on the FLD and deformation results, the mould is designed. Manufacturer¿s stamping experiments have shown that the agreement between simulation and experiment is good.

articleTitle: Modern design application of chinese traditional gardening theory of “man living in harmony with nature”
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The traditional theory on Chinese gardens that man is integral part of nature has existed for a long time, reflecting Chinese ancestors/ attitudes towards nature formed in their production and life. This theory views that man and nature should live in harmony, and that Chinese traditional garden should learn from and be in harmony with the nature. Thereout is my study on study on modern landscape design.

articleTitle: The digital protection of intangible cultural heritage —The construction of digital museum
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper is going to discuss the application and researches of digital in the protection of intangible cultural heritage, and stresses on the issues involved in the construction of digital museum, such as the artistic form applied in the construction, the humanistic concerns in the construction, the psychological analysis of the intending visitors of the museum, and the interaction between the visitors and museum. In this way, while the goal of protecting intangible cultural heritage is reached, another bran-new visiting mode is created to make visitors find interaction and enjoyment in a larger degree.

articleTitle: PERT in product design application
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: On account of the high effective and complexity of the design activities, it is necessary to have a time management in the design process. PERT is a method for making the reasonable plan and controlling to the project overall time, before the project was carried out. If this method applies in the product design project, it can enhance working efficiency of the design activity. In order to establish the reasonable project activity sequence, the design manager can make the detailed division and three kind of time estimates (optimistic time, most possible time and pessimistic time) of the product design procedure¿s events. Through the analysis and combination of activity sequence, the manager can calculate most early start-working time, most late start-working time as well as the total time difference of each active event,the market investigation, the summarized report of survey, setting up the design team and so on, and may find out the design activities in the critical path. By controlling these activities, the design manager can reduce the product development time effectively, and guarantee the highly effective of product design.

articleTitle: Pixel level image fusion scheme based on accumulated gradient and PCA transform
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A new image fusion scheme based on local accumulated gradient and PCA transform is prese nted. The image fusion process begins by taking the wavelet transform of the source images. Then, the fused local detailed coefficients are chosen according to local accumulated gradient rule, and the fused approximate coefficients are acquired by selection or averaging rule based on PCA. Finally, the fused image can be obtained by taking the inverse wavelet transform of the fused composite coefficients. The experimental results show that the proposed method is an efficient approach to image fusion

articleTitle: On Ink and Wash Language Using in Designs
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The reason that the ink and wash has its charm because of its contingency in the process of creation, their use of lines, pen and ink, shades, wet and dry, and other practices, the use of artificial language and symbols to express ink language, qualitative and summarized it even more difficult. This is also the reason that ink and wash language is so difficult to be used in design. Otherwise we can not deny the infectiousness of ink and wash language and its artistic impact on design. Growing numbers of outstanding designers’ entry in the painting are to find inspiration. This paper approaches Ink and Wash Language Using in Designs from the three aspects: expressive form beauty, material beauty and artistic conception beauty.

articleTitle: Combining art and science of the integration of designs
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The combination of science and art fully mobilize the left-brain and right brain. It is the science that makes imagination to become reality. If there is no art, science perhaps does not bring to happy to us. The fusion design is mutual infiltration; logical thinking and non-logic thinking will help the creative thinking. The combination of science and arts is the genius to create the epiphany. Science and art create new art forms. The purpose of science and art is the same. The combination of science and art creates a new culture. The integration of design value is greater than the sum of all parts.

articleTitle: White space design and its application for website interface
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: White space design is a kind of unique visual aesthetic design form, which is typical, prosperous and full of challenges. By this way, white space on the website interface shows the wealthy emotion of human beings. Different white space will produce different psychological feelings of the visual and aesthetic qualities, so that it can lead to a broader art space beyond the concrete design. This paper first discusses the advantages of white space design in visual communication and visual psychology, and then studies the special artistic influence of white space in Website interface design. At the end, we point out that Website designers should make the best use of white space for interface, in order to have the wonderful performance for the interface. A good Web design works by using white space on the interface is full of clear meaning, which can create a nice mood, and inspires viewers to think widely, as well broadens their visual thinking.

articleTitle: The preliminary exploration of Experimental District for Digital media education integrated arts and technology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The education of digital media specialty has an interdisciplinary nature. The interdisciplinary practice and the exploration of digital media teaching in the Experimental District of Digital media in Zhejiang University are introduced in this paper. The advantages of College of Software and College of Arts are integrated, the teaching philosophy based on interdisciplinary approach and Institute-enterprise cooperation is explored, the experimental teaching reform is carried out, and the innovation groups of digital media are organized to improve the personnel training of digital media specialty.

articleTitle: Design of a metamodel-based telecoms modelling language
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Along with the evolution of computer technology, language oriented programming came out as a revolutionary progress which beyond the object-oriented programming. In current object-oriented programming, the general modeling language UML lacks of rich syntax and semantics in the specific domain. Developing and using domain specific language model in the progress of language oriented programming can solve this problem well. By constructing a executable model based on the MOF, defining an abstract syntax model and an concrete syntax model and extending semantics, this paper designs a telecommunication topology modelling language TML which based on the MOF metamodel .TML contains rich syntax, semantics and constraints which are telecommunication domain specific, and has the executable feature, thus it greatly simplifies the complexity of system modelling in domain and enhances the efficiency of software production.

articleTitle: New expression of humanization product design under the background of digital technology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Digital technology has made a tremendous impact on humanization design of products. In the specifically product design, these effects mainly manifest themselves in the following three aspects which include form, function and human-computer interaction design. As the progress of processing technology and the emerging of new materials and technologies, the products modeling become ¿diversification¿ and ¿miniaturization¿, and the use of software promoted the diversification of product, improved the efficiency and security of products. The content of product¿s interactive design have some changes, which is mainly a transformation from the single ¿hard¿ interface to the multi-interface combines ¿soft and hard¿ interfaces.

articleTitle: Analyze the requirement of product rendering software based on goal-oriented design method
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Starting from the value of product rendering, this article emphasizes the importance of ideal rendering software to industrial designers. Moreover, through the goal-oriented design methods, this paper establishes a user model to analyze the user characteristics of the rendering software, and suggests that generating the rendering with commercial photography effect should be taken as the ultimate goal of rendering software. Based on the persona-based scenarios analysis, this paper describes the specific requirements on the software in the process of product rendering. Then, in accordance with these requirements, a comparative assessment between Autodesk Imagestudio and Bunkspeed Hypershot - two typical representatives of rendering software - is conducted, and both their strengths and weaknesses are analyzed. This study will help software designers to have a better understanding of the users, goals and requirements of their product rendering software, thus enabling them to give birth to ideal rendering software.

articleTitle: Development of corrugatec box packaging CAD software system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The value of packaging in people’s daily life is playing an increasingly important role. Among the many exquisite packaging of goods, corrugated boxes tacke up the first position. Although the corrugated CAD software has been used widely in the international market, but the design and production of corrugated boxes in the domestic corporation still mainly depend on manual operation. The development of corrugated CAD system is the main object of this paper. The detail of the corrugated box in the design process, material selection, size, strength, strength checking is discussed in this paper, then the establishment of a computerized design flow chart is summed up. Visual Basic programming language is used to complete procedures. The software has a friendly user interface; can automatically determine the number of contents and the arrangement; calculate internal and external dimensions; check stacking and compressive strength, and so on.

articleTitle: Designing of testing simulation training system of missile based on virtual instrument technology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The testing simulation training system of missile with complete function and superior capability is developed on the base of Windows platform by comprehensive use of advanced technologies such as the virtual instrument, simulation modelling, logical reasoning, information analysis, information synchronous control, multimedia, etc. This paper emphatically introduces the structure of the simulation training system and the implementation method of each function module, puts forward a new modelling way to realize the logical reasoning function by the digitalization of the system circuit. With the background maintenance and the maintenance of the component database, the simulation training system can be put up quickly and the teaching and training of the visual system can be realized, which resolves the difficulty of unclose unity of the real fixing and the theory in the comprehensive test training that has perplexed for a long time, playing an important guiding role for the research and development of the large-scale missile simulation test equipment.

articleTitle: Usability evaluation on websites
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: As the development of information society, the use of the Internet and other forms of information and communications technology becomes increasingly popular. Nowadays, millions of Websites have been built and placed into service. More and more designers have begun to focus their attention on whether these Websites can be used easily. Therefore, how to measure the usability is an important question in website design. With the help of evaluating methods, designers can understand their users better, and make their works meet their users¿ needs. The quality of the usability evaluation lies on evaluating techniques. This paper describes how to use these methods to evaluate a Website. First, the common evaluating procedure is introduced in this paper. Secondly some usability evaluation techniques are introduced, which are usability testing, heuristic evaluation, cognitive walkthrough, focus group, thinking aloud and questionnaires. In the end, how to use these methods will be discussed.

articleTitle: “People-oriented” in electronic product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The real aim of industrial design is to create the real quality of product, namely the optimization of product’s structure, function and principle, and to make products enhance their own value in the market through this relationship. In order to adapt to the product design in electronic age, we propose the “people-oriented” design concept, so as to achieve coordinating the optimization of products through “human” factors, and creating the real quality of product. This study focuses on the application direction of the “people-oriented” design concept and how this concept is used in the electronic product design. In the paper, I mainly enterprises in the design and production of the “baby monitor” products, as discussed in the example illustrates.

articleTitle: Research and analysis on the shape of construction machinery
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Shape design for construction machinery is the weak link of construction machinery industry. However, shape design shows the concern of the human, reflect the coordination of the man-machine system, as well as unite art and science organically. The analysis on the shape of construction machinery from the perspective of semantics, can help to lay a solid foundation for the product development and design on shape. It will be a tough task for designers to apply the method to the original design.

articleTitle: The spirit, mental connotation and philosophic essence of general design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: General design has always been existing between human and nature, as an innovative intelligent activity, general design has a profound and lasting contribution on the society and its collaborative existence and development with nature. Through the comprehensive analysis and study of general design¿s connotation and property, based on the deep analysis and philosophic exploration of design¿s spirit, this paper proposes definitely that scientific general design is human being¿s intelligent activity and conducting beacon, analyzes design¿s encrypted property rationally from eight aspects and expounds that general design philosophy¿s essence is the impassioned motive force for activating and keeping human being¿s creative mind, innovative ability, wisdom advancement and life force, and certainly a strong guarantee for human to avoid corruption and even destruction.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of 3D mannequin by two-dimensional photos
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper introduce a new way to build the individuated 3D human body modeling by using two 2D photos to reconstruct 3D Mannequins which including 3D human body modeling and 3D human face modeling. Our work mainly concentrates in extracting human body feature points from 2D photos by the theory of anthropometry and converting these feature points to deformation parameters which will be applied to the initial 3D model of the human body.

articleTitle: The research of affect computing use in users’ satisfaction measurement in usability testing
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the problem that the important usability attribute - the users’ subjective satisfaction is difficult to quantified in today’s usability testing, the users’ affective model based on the process of users’ behavior in usability testing is proposed in this paper by studying the principle of the emotion generation and the process of the user experience, which is used to measure users’ satisfaction to improve its accuracy and credibility.

articleTitle: Application of multilevel 2-D wavelet transform in image compression
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The compression processing of fingerprint image is of great importance in the computer fingerprint recognition system. Based on analyzing the frequent image compression methods, the author studies the image compression methods with multi-scale two-dimensional wavelet transform, and put forward a new fingerprint image compression evaluation method.

articleTitle: A new watermarking Scheme for CAD engineering drawings
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: So far most watermarking schemes focus mainly on common dot image, audio, video and text. Studies on the watermarking of vector graphics especially the 2D vector engineering drawings have only just begun. This paper proposed a novel watermarking technique for 2D engineering drawings, which is based on Modulus operation and Hopfield network. Watermark is embedded proportionately into the lengths of lines from an engineering drawing via Modulus calculation and can be extracted without exploiting the original engineering drawing. To improve the security of watermarking, we preprocess the watermark data using Arnold transform before embedding. By means of Hopfield network the extracted watermark can be further recovered and amended effectively. Experimental results show the proposed watermarking scheme is almost completely robust to rotate, scale, transplant (RST) as well as their combinations, and also strong enough to cropping attacks.

articleTitle: A study on the method of satisfaction measurement based on emotion space
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: User satisfaction, as an important indicator in usability testing, directly reflects users’ acceptance of the product and to be the most concerned issue in many enterprises and usability departments. Finding out the shortages of satisfaction measurement in current usability testing, this paper took the basic operation processes in the user experience as the staring point, and analyzed the mapping relationship between the users’ actions and emotions based on the theory of the emotion space. Considering the impact of the differences in human personality, this paper mapped the user experience difficult measured to a standard user emotion space model PAD, combined with the theories of emotion generation and affective computing, to get the method of user satisfaction measurement and finally to gain the process of user emotion changes in usability testing.

articleTitle: Problems and solutions on the teaching of Computer-aided industrial design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The rapid development of Computer-aided design technology makes a tremendous change on the industrial product design. Mastering computer-aided design technology has become the requisite capacity of industrial design professionals. Computer-aided industrial design courses have become a compulsory subject in many colleges and universities. This article is a research on the teaching of computer-aided industrial design courses. The problems are discussed on the development and current situation, computer-aided industrial design curriculum, content, teaching methods of these courses. And several solutions are raised that establishing a reasonable computer-aided industrial design curriculum, increasing difficulty of the courses, improving the teaching methods.

articleTitle: Analysis on the design of child safety seats in vehicle
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: When cars come into more and more families, it is increasingly long time for children to stay in the vehicle. It is gradually arouse people¿s attention that there are many child casualties problems caused by vehicle accidents. Thus child seat become the most effective and general products just because it can resolve those problems . The article analysed the importance of the design of child seat for vehicle, at the same time, it proposed the basic design principles and design approach to improve the comfort and security of children. Finally, it further analysed of the design of child safety seats through outstanding examples.

articleTitle: Real 2D presentation of spatial solids and real presentation rate with fuzzy pattern recognition I—concept and principles
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: It is an inevitable trend for the realistic visualization to be accomplished for spatial solids with two-dimensional presentation. In the parallel projection system in which the viewing angle and the presenting angle are consistent, the concepts and evaluation indexes are put forward. Based on the comparison among the five methods, statistic pattern recognition, syntax pattern recognition, fuzzy pattern recognition, nerve-net method, and reasoning method, for determination of the design of 2-D presentation, studies in detail the principles of fuzzy pattern recognition and considerations, indicating clearly the laws of subjection, threshold, closeness and nearness- selection. With fuzzy pattern recognition it is quick and convenient to obtain the location and the real presentation rate of 2-D presentation for the spatial objects.

articleTitle: An improved computing method for distance between Cubic Bézier curve and corresponding chord
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Cubic Bézier curve is one of most basic and important drawing objects in computer graphics, and has wide applications in computer aided geometric design. How to draw curves quickly and accurately is a research direction at present. In traditional drawing algorithms, the distance between cubic Bézier curve and corresponding chord can be approximatively computed with the maximum value of distance between the middle two control points and corresponding chord. In this paper, an improved computing method based on Cauchy Median Theorem is proposed, by which the accurate value can be worked out and the segmentation count can be reduced. The related experiment is carried out for random generated data, the results show that the improved method can reduce the segmentation count and the computing cost meets the demand of pratical application.

articleTitle: Cultural symbols in furniture design: A research on the evolution path of Ming furniture’s molding design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Ming furniture marks the peak in the design history of traditional Chinese furniture. The present article attempts to explore the reasons leading to the gradual changes in the molding design of Ming furniture, with the role that “four-side flushed” construction once played in the molding of Ming furniture and the process in which it was replaced by “recessed waist” construction as the focus of this study. An analysis of the practical and aesthetic needs of the times shows that aesthetic orientation as affected by the general cultural environemnt has been the driving force behind the selection of design molds of Ming furniture. Such a realization will help us to create new classics in contemporary furniture design by taking full advantage of cultural factors.

articleTitle: The mathematical simulation of a new equipment for particle conveying
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This article brings out a brand-new equipment—Screw-gas Bulk Sucking and Taking Equipment for the solution, which applies both the theory of vertical screw conveyor and the theory of pneumatic handling. It constitutes of 3 parts; respectively from bottom to above they are: Centrifugal force Separating Part, Screw Lifting Part and Pneumatic Conveying Part. Particle material is drawn into the equipment in the form of gas-solid two-phase flow by the Atmospheric pressure, and then helically rises in the Centrifugal Force Separating Part which is an inverted cone. The material would be separated from the two-phase flow by the effect of centrifugal force and then be lifted in the Screw Lifting Part. The gas flow with the very little remained material would be drawn into the blower. By thus Screw-gas Bulk Sucking and Taking Equipment could take the material and put it to the next conveying process conveniently and efficiently. The article provides the mathematical simulation of the characteristics of separating surfaces of the material during the conveying process. Four types of separating curves have been found with the decision of the corresponding required conditions. The calculation based on Matlab proves the correctness of the assumptions and analysis.

articleTitle: Decorative pattern design of ceramic based on cloud model and fractal art
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The original design of ceramics patterns based on the cloud model and fractal art is a new method to decorate the appearance of ceramic with computer technology. Computer with fractal theory of digital technology can create the patterns in which there are different kinds of objects whose styles seem to imitate the growth postures of plants coming from nature. We advanced some fractal algorithms, which make the algorithms performance more powerful and improve the efficiency of fractal images making, those strategies allow the art effect of fractal images to develop into be better and higher level and to exert their potentials. In order to be better to obtain rich and colorful fractal images, we open up the basic principle of the cloud model of uncertainty intelligence used to imitate the drift phenomenon of plants growth in nature and to design to render the ceramics pattern¿s appearance, producing different and surprising art patterns with different styles and colors. Furthermore, the images can be beautified by the computer image manipulation software and append some synthetic art tint, which let fractal images become design materials of ceramics patterns with great quality. The experiment indicates that the new method, compared with the traditional one, makes the ceramics patters have some characters such as better art property, higher quality, richer color and elegant temperament and so on.

articleTitle: Real-time tree model reconstructing for fruit harvesting robot system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on OpenGL, the real-time reconstruction of the fruit tree¿s model was built. The shape of tree¿s trunk and branch, which are the main obstacles for harvesting task in a fruit harvesting robot system, can be simplified as a combination of different cylinder modules overlap in the obstacle-avoidance. Even at the branch node, the module can be used. The cylinder perspective law is employed to get the cylinder¿s diameter. Supported by on-line image-gathering and analyzing system, the cylinder diameter¿s coordinate is easier to get. Calculate the coordinate value of points which divide the circle into 12 equal parts, and then use polygonal approximation to construct the modules. Eventually the whole tree is reconstructed to supply farther work of obstacle-avoidance with virtual scene. The experimental results illustrated that, for the mid-complicated tree modeling, the reconstruction method can yield a real-time model.

articleTitle: Digital aided technology research on Chinese traditional art design - case for paper-cut
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: For the rational mode of intervention of the traditional arts’ protection and promotion from CAD technology, the paper researches on the computer-aided design technology of paper-cut art design. Based on the protection of artists’ creative thinking, creativity and production in designing process are divided effectively. The inefficient repeating and uncreative works in paper-cut art are completed by using CAD technology. Artists’ creative thinking are fleetly expressed with lots of schemas and works’ production is aided perfectly. Based on digital CAD technology theory, paper-cut element symbols database are picked-up. Paper-cut CAD system based on CorelDraw is implemented by using the technology of plane array parameterization, path decoration, folding and combination of lots of schemas. The designing process validation is carried through with typical traditional designs.

articleTitle: Analysis of factors influencing cutting quality and strength parameters of rolling cut shears
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Rolling cut shears are important equipments of steel plate production. They have significant influences on the quantity and quality of products. There are many relative factors that influence the performance of rolling cut shears. For the optimization of mechanism design of rolling cut shears, a CAD software has been developed and was used for the analysis of the factors such as crank radius, link rod length, phase difference, center distance of cranks and the offset position of upper blade carriage, which influence cutting quality and strength parameters. The study results provide the designers with important references. The developed CAD software can be used for optimization design of rolling cut shears.

articleTitle: Analysis of cognitive behavior in software interactive interface
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Software interface design is an important component part of human-computer interaction system. Users conduct information communication effectively with computers through software interface, and then to complete their task. Software interface design embodies ¿human-centered¿ design concepts, emphasize the perfect combination of ¿people¿ and ¿thing¿. During the process of software design, the designer depends on establish concept, users¿ behavior, interface design order and stands on the users¿ view, from the users¿ standpoint, giving full considerations to the needs of users. Combining with some basic principles of cognitive psychology, this paper analyzes the cognitive behavior of software interactive interface design from the cognitive aspect of information processing, perception, memory, thinking, and users¿ psychological response characteristics in the process of software interface, and combining with the basic characteristics of the usability testing, this paper puts forward the improving method of software interactive interface design, explores the software interface design influences on users, and tries to find elements which can improve the interaction and availability of software interactive interface and makes the software interface design more usability and humanization.

articleTitle: Research for conceptual design of drilling fixture based on fuzzy algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
