abstract: Relative position between processing factor of processed spares and machining cutter to be fixed and maintained is the main function of machining fixture, which is decomposed location function and clamp function and connection function between machining and its fixture and presetter and introduction function as well as division function in this paper, Consequently function tree of machining fixture design to be formed. Morphological matrix of conceptual design for drilling fixture is constructed according to function tree of machining fixture design and its specific design requirements. Concept of fuzzy distance measure is introduced to decide the final ranking of alternatives. To avoid the combination explosion, an algorithm-based heuristic solving strategy is subsequently proposed by defining the heuristic evaluation function as a fuzzy multi-criteria decision-making.

articleTitle: Adaptive interactive evolutionary computation for cctive intent-oriented design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Through human participation in the search-and-selection process, an interactive evolutionary computation-based design environment can offer industrial designers an exploration studio for the stimulation of creativity through evolution of continually emerging shapes, helping them to attain models with certain design intent. Such stochastic searches possibly bring user fatigue because of long-time iteration. In order to accelerate the evolving process, adaptive mechanisms of evolutionary computation are used to actively capture the design intent during a man-machine interactive modeling process, adapting the design-evolution process to support the designer in quickly finding appreciated solutions in the midst of giant possibilities. To test the proposed concept of active intent-oriented design, two interactive evolution strategies-based curve modifiers - with and without adaptation - are implemented as plugins with a conventional CAD tool. Primitive experimental results are presented to show the potential of the proposed concept.

articleTitle: Effect of automotive headlamp modeling on automotive aerodynamic drag
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Automotive headlamp design, combining science with art, is essential in automotive modeling design. Headlamp modeling design should consider harmonizing with automotive modeling design as well as meeting the national standards of structural design and lighting property. The research aims to present an approach for headlamp modeling design considering automotive aerodynamic drag. The effect of different headlamp modeling design on aerodynamic drag and accordingly three sorts of parameters of headlamp modeling design combining with aesthetic demand are studied. An analytic model of headlamp on automotive aerodynamic drag is established. Numerical simulation of 3-D flow field around the automobile with CFD software is performed. The change of drag coefficient with parameters is analyzed. Finally the design rules of headlamp aerodynamic modeling optimization are concluded. The research effort will enrich the design means of automotive modeling and automotive headlamp, so as to improve the technical property.

articleTitle: Research on virtual exhibition interaction and user experience technology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: User experience is the subjective feeling of the product. In virtual environment, the user experience is the user’s interaction with the virtual environment; generated behaviors by the expectations, perceptions, feelings and others; and the memory, attitudes, feelings after use. This paper discussed the user experience model based on the computer multimedia environment and implementation of the virtual exhibition prototype system.

articleTitle: A study of CAID teaching
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The computer science has been developing rapidly in 21st century; it also brings an innovatory design tool to the field of Industry Design. It is the ¿Computer-Aided Industrial Design¿(CAID) system. The application of CAID system makes the industrial design standards have a qualitative change in design methodology, design flow, Design performance of the quality and efficiency of all aspects. CAID in the College of Industrial Design Teaching has gradually become a very important professional course. This paper discusses the Development Status and Problems in today¿s CAID teaching, and proposed the possible solutions and suggestions of CAID teaching and studying.

articleTitle: Garment design at the age of experience economy
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: After the human society has entered into the 21st century, one new economic form-experience economy followed service economy appeared, which is a new stage of economic development since1990s. As the experience economy is forming, consumers’ attention on the garment products has been changing from their inherent function to pleasant emotion experience which would help to quiet human’s soul. That is, the pure inclination towards rational demand has developed into individuation demand to pursue self-fulfillment. At the same time, the connotation of garment design also changed in terms of this trend. The product would not only have the value of inherent function, but also have the intrinsic value of culture and spirit. Based on experience economy, experience designing and experience, the paper analyzes the main features of garment design in experience economy times, illustrates the related methods and principles of experiencing garment design and tries to offer an instructive thought to experiencing garment design.

articleTitle: Study on the manufacturing base oriented collaborative serving system development and key technology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: How to immediately use the existing manufacturing information resource and how to make full use of the enterprises’ interior developing strength is a very key technology to implement the manufacturing base plan. The development of collaborative serving supporting system will be a great impact on this plan. In this paper, the general framework of collaborative serving supporting system is described first. Then the two main subsystems including of the manufacturing information system and the collaborative serving system are given. The detailed researching content holding within the two subsystems are discussed, too. The features of this supporting system can be described as the flowing three features: Multi-roles development oriented feature. Item management oriented feature. Enterprise alliance oriented feature. In the end, the prototype system is developed. The mainly modules such as the manufacturing commerce information module in the manufacturing base information serving system and the item management module, e-whiteboard drawing postil module in the collaborative serving system are included.

articleTitle: Cooperative design on auto body layout basing on KBE in CATIA V5
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The use of CATIA V5 strong knowledge base on engineering and parametric modeling capabilities, and organically combining the two, collaborative design of the car body layout can achieve. The entire relevant parametric auto body layout driven by knowledge can be realized basing on character of object and the connection between characters.

articleTitle: Research on key technology of quality management supporting digitized design and manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Along with rapid development of manufacturing informatization, the present quality management system is difficult to support the current requirements of digitized design and manufacturing, which includes the weakness as: the quality data managing mode is behindhand, the quality management information has few information flow interface with other systems, the information exchange is still going on with paper medium. This paper proposes a five tiers platform for the quality management system. For the multi-requirement in the quality information inputting, propose a dynamic table technology by use word as information collection station, establish a mapping between the collection information and field in the database. To implement the task flow between the work stations, propose a method to rebuild workflow engine. Encapsulate the quality information by using XML. Make XML file flow through maintenance a file ID on the file server. By this way, workflow engine can satisfy the requirement of the increasing quality information.

articleTitle: The research of group decision methods for product design evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The product design evaluation and decision plays a very important role in product quality improvement. Having studied the product design evaluation, decision, and group decision methods, the paper put forward the theory of group decision methods for design evaluation to improve the product design evaluation. Linking with product design evaluation features the paper researched some individual evaluation and group decision methods. The evaluation problems generating database (EPGD) and evaluation problems solving database (EPSD) were built, so as to help decision makers to evaluate product design projects according to their feature and preference. The evaluation and group decision methods and the two databases are the foundations to structure the group decision support system (GDSS) for product design evaluation. They can help decision-makers to evaluate the product design projects and assemble the group decision data to ensure a scientific and credible result. The research improved the product design evaluation theory and methods, and was valuable for the improvement of design evaluation.

articleTitle: Design for the need of tactile feeling
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper intends to discuss the potential tactile need of human and resort to design-especially industrial design-to fulfill it, in other words, to rediscover the basic need and encourage people to notice it. Touch feeling may be not only a subordinative consideration in industrial design and we expect the possible popularity of future touch-contented products. The paper consists of four parts: the importance and potential need of touch feeling, the current design research and products connecting touch feeling and the future design trend to satisfy touch feeling. It will be based on observations, interviews of typical people and a questionnaire survey, which intertwine together thus to make the analysis more convincing, to achieve the final result.

articleTitle: Cognitive pragmatics relations in product symbol accepted process
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present systemic cognitive pragmatics relations between product symbol and user for product symbol innovation. According to the theories of cognitive pragmatics, the cognitive pragmatics theory in product design was established. Combining with elements of semiotics, the work presented in this paper analyzed cognitive process with `denotation-connotation-function¿ and cognitive methods with `analogical relationship, logic relationship and conventional relationship¿ of product symbol. Based on this, the research showed the cognitive pragmatics relationships and resented some typical cases for these relations in cognition process of product symbol. The results indicated that these relationships mainly include the cognition-behavior relations with `logic cognition-practical behavior¿, `iconic cognition-emotional behavior¿ and `symbolic cognition-cultural behavior¿, and the characters and functions of three kinds of cognition-behavior context, such as operation context, scenario context and cultural context. These relations can contribute a lot to creative thinking and scientific methods for designers in new product development.

articleTitle: The application of computer aided shape simulation technique in steel tower segment fabrication of Nanjing 3rd Yangtze River Bridge
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Nanjing Yangtze river 3rd bridge is the first bridge that uses the steel structure as the main tower in China. The inclination of the steel tower has a great influence on the security of the whole bridge. Because of the big size, the steel tower had to be divided to 22 segments in factory and erected segment by segment bridge site. Because of the connection mode of the segments, the shape of the steel tower can not be adjusted during erection and the fabrication error of each segment will be accumulated and propagated during erection. Accordingly, high precision of the mechanical cutting of each segment end face was required and the fabrication error of each segment must be strictly controlled. In this paper, we gave the computer aided shape simulation technique aiming at the precision evaluation and control of segment fabrication of the steel tower. The technique has been applied successfully to the construction of Nanjing 3rd Yangtze river bridge.

articleTitle: An application of industrial design in Large-scale Agricultural Machinery
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the development of agricultural modernization and mechanization, industrial design, as an important part of modern product, will play an important role in Agricultural Engineering and the design and product of agricultural machinery. At first the paper promotes the main three aspects of application of ID in Agricultural Engineering. Then based on the full design process of a self-propelled Forage Harvester, the paper shows how industrial design is applied to Large-scale Agricultural Machinery. According to “Feature doctrine”, we develop various solutions in design process, then judge and compare various solutions by 3d-model, and then test and modify the final solution by solid model in FRP. The final product’s appearance was improved greatly and its usability was improved too, but its cost was not significantly improved.

articleTitle: Post-Expressionism style in modern car design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The modern car design pays more attention to express its unique character which is consistent with expressionism in some aspects. In this article, the author borrows some thoughts of expressionism and brings forward the trend of post-expressionism in modern car design. The author detailedly analyzed the design of the car from the overall design and the detail design: the sports style and the feeling of strength are strengthening in whole view, especially, the use of curve has changed a lot than ever; the expression of car emotion is enhanced by the detail design of front face and lights. Overall, the dynamic sense of car design is increasing, meanwhile, car styling has also become more attractive.

articleTitle: Dynamics model and dynamic simulation of overhead crane load swing systems based on the ADAMS
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: According to dynamics computation model of the overhead crane, analyse the load swing when the small trolley is moving, and obtain the swing kinematics equation of the load. Further, carry out the computer dynamic simulation with the 32t double beams overhead crane as an instance whose results verify the swing kinematics equation and represent the true moving process of the load when the small trolley is moving. That research method is portable so that it is suitable for researches on the load swing of other type cranes such as Shore container hoist crane, gantry crane and so on.

articleTitle: The degree reduction of tensor product rational Bézier surfaces
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The objective of this paper is to present methods to solve the problem of the degree reduction of rational Bézier surfaces with endpoints continuity. Firstly, under homogenous spaces, we apply degree reduction of the polynomials Bézier surfaces in L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> norm to the rational Bézier surfaces respectively. In addition, we derive conditions for the reduced-degree weights ϖ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> >0, and point out that the degree reduction methods under the homogenous coordinates is only sufficient condition; secondly, under the affine space, necessary and sufficient condition for the c<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sup> -continuity at the endpoints is given. Based on the multi-objective optimization, we utilize Genetic Algorithm achieve the reduction of rational surfaces. Finally several numerical examples are presented to illustrate the effects of methods.

articleTitle: Research on the scene displaying scheme of the training simulator for crane
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Generally, the special working environment of cranes brings forward some particular requirements for the design of scene displaying of crane operator training simulator. This paper firstly introduced some traditional scene displaying methods. Corresponding 3D description and analysis were given. Then considering the operating environment characters of the crane’s operator, comparison and evaluation for the traditional methods were given by several important vision exhibition properties. In order to solve their shortage, a new Augmented Virtuality (AV) displaying scheme was proposed. Its basic idea and principle were set forth. Some disadvantages and their resolving approaches were also mentioned simply.

articleTitle: The design of electric power equipment information search system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Starting with the current situation and development of electric power equipment information administration, structured a networked electric power equipment images management Information System that is safe, reliable and efficient to run. System is on basic of B/S structure, realizes dynamic interactive Web application based on MVC frame, adopting SIFT algorithm to carry out fast matching, realize retrieval and classification for equipment photographs in image database, program execution of BLOB interface aiming at JDBC achieved storage, display for equipment photograph and relevant information. In addition, malfunction administration module is able to add abnormal equipment information such ad exceed the time limit with the service life or consumer thinks false to abnormal form, warn of operators at the regular time.

articleTitle: Investigation and realization of embedded GIS display technology basing on multi-task scheduling
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Embedded GIS is the basic platform of the remotion geographic information service, and it is one of the critical technologies to accomplish the real time display when the resource of platform is limited. Basing on the contrastingly analyzing of the current display technology of the geographic information, and combining with the demanding of our project, the paper presents a real time display technology of map which is basing on task scheduling, and realizes the real time display of the images and series-scale vector maps on two kinds of Embedded Platform whose core is ARM, it costs less than 1 second to browse the maps and it could satisfy the demand of practical application.

articleTitle: An optimization-based arm posture prediction in presence of obstacles
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In recent years, digital human model is increasingly applied to simulation-based product design. Safely manual operation often requires avoiding collision with obstacles in the workspace. How to detect possible collisions and predict viable work posture to avoid obstacles will be an important tool for computer-aided ergonomics and optimization of system design in the early stage of a design process. In this paper, an optimization-based method is presented to predict work posture in presence of obstacles. In order to predict realistic and safe work posture, we consider the discomfort level of human performance measure as the optimization goal, and we address the problem by incorporating sparse nonlinear optimizer (SNOPT) toolkit, which is suitable for large-scale constrained optimization. Firstly, we describe the digital human model in Jack. Secondly, we define the variables and constraints for this constrained optimization problem, introduce an approximate approach to test whether collision constraints violates, and give the formulation of the problem. Finally, we adopt the optimization model to predict posture, which minimizes the discomfort level function with the subject to collision-free constraints. Unlike the existing methods to predict work posture of upper limbs, our method mainly focuses on realistic and collision-free posture, and we develop an optimization model to address the problem. Our simulation results indicate that the proposed method is feasible for predicting obstacle avoidance posture.

articleTitle: Enhancing the college students’ creativity in industrial design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Most instructors in industrial design have been trained as designer, not have been trained to teach highly creative students. This paper firstly examines the western and eastern perspectives of creativity and successful creative individuals, and then reveals specific creative characteristics of the students. In the end, the methods of enhancing the creativity are discussed.

articleTitle: 3D modeling and functional design of reading room in a virtual library
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Virtual reality technology has been widely applied in many different fields, which has large development potentiality and good prospect. This paper involves related technologies of virtual reality based on the PC and construction of a walk-through system. The realistic feeling of panorama images and the real-time properties while roaming are designed. The library of Liaoning Shihua University is taken for the research example. For the modeling of the library based on the 3DS Max software and the VRML language, the author focuses on the function design of the virtual reading room. The JavaScript language node is used and the VRML language and Java language are connected with the database. The virtual library walk-through system and information inquiry technology are implemented.

articleTitle: Implementation of 3D sound effect modeling technology based on vehicle driving simulator
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Sound simulation system of virtual driving environment of auditory perception module, can make up for the lack of a single visual information to enhance the driver of the interactive virtual driving environment and the judgement of the spot realistic driving simulator, in order to better complete the training and driving training mission. This article discusses the virtual 3D positioning in the voice of principle, sound attenuation distance model, the Doppler effect and sound formula, and other key technologies on the two voices in the virtual space development kits OpenAL, DirectSound; under simulated driving For the practical application, given some applications and examples of relevant research which should be focus on in the field of staff have a certain value.

articleTitle: Enlightenment of design education by ecological design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Any form of design coordinated with the ecological process and trying to minimize its destructive impact on the environment can be referred to as an ecological design. Through investigation in the new concept of ecological design as well as the design principle of the entire system etc, this paper points out that design education serves an irreplaceable role for ecological protection, and ecological design can be realized in an all-round way only through the reform of design education, the enhancement of trans-disciplinary intersection and fusion, and the formation of correct ecological values in students etc.

articleTitle: On the use of Chinese elements with fun spirit in product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, more and more people infatuated with Chinese culture. Chinese elements with her unique charms are sweeping across the fashion stage. The elements which can represent the characteristics of the Chinese culture have become the designer¿s new favorite. How to integrate Chinese elements with fashion elements? How to use Chinese elements in product design with the contemporary aesthetics concept and contemporary art forms? It is worth thinking and trying by designers. This paper explores the use of Chinese elements in product design from the perspective of fun spirit. In the context of the consumerism and the entertainment culture, design is also a kind of entertainment activities. Design is fun, and fun is also design. The originally serious Chinese elements should now show the fun.

articleTitle: GUI design: From information architecture to interactive experience
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper analyzes Graphic User Interface (GUI) design bases on Nathan Shedroff’s theory about data, information and knowledge. Actually, interface is the information between data and knowledge. User is the center of classifying and organizing information, and all kinds of methods base on user should be chosen. And graphic becomes the medium to transform and restructure the user information, which should follow such principles as relevancy, signification and objective. In the case study of web navigation graphic, the author analyzes embedded frame, tree frame, ladder frame and ZIP. From the viewpoint of media evolvement and human behavior, it points out that interactivity is the meta-media, and the essence of the interactivity is human interaction. Bearing these on mind, the author analyzes that the users are dissociating between the truth and the virtual, which makes the interaction more extensive; the new interaction based on the co-existence and co- evolvement between human and computer can be created by making good use of technology; and what to be innovated is not only the interactive “object”, but the interactive “affair”, whose core is still to create experiences full of meaning. Consequently, Web GUI design is not only an esthetical form, but also information architecture to communicate effectively and human user experience.

articleTitle: Design and application of visualization of assembly process
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: At all time, assembly is one of the most important components of product developments. Visualization of assembly process would radically change the model of design and manufacture. This paper introduced the main content of it, put out the model of design visualization in assembly process which including establish assembly model, assembly process simulation, assembly feasibility analyzing and evaluate modifying bugs. Finally, the model was applied in visualization assembly process of the new coaling machine in this paper. It will be used for reference on new product development.

Author Keywords: Assembly Process Visualization Assembly Coaling Machine

articleTitle: The performance of the cultural forms of arts and crafts
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The styles of arts and crafts in different times are affected by the cultures and histories at their times. This paper focuses on the combination between the development of arts and crafts and the characteristics of the history and culture during Tang and Song Dynasties, Tang Dynasty is exoteric, and its industrial arts, which is free, comely and magnificent, resulted in its syncretic culture. While Song Dynasty is rational, its introverted culture leads to the industrial arts that is implicative and full of elegance. The research on the influences that cultures have on the development of arts and crafts and seeking for the interior embodiment of the culture during Tang and Song Dynasty in the development of the arts and crafts will be a revelatory help for us to create the best productions that possesses the characteristics of both times as well as our nations.

articleTitle: Study on a method for rebuilding tooth surfaces of Planar Double-Enveloping Toroidal Worm-Gear
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to manufacture Planar Double-Enveloping Toroidal Worm-Gear by CNC technology, an accurate 3-D digital model of each tooth must be constructed. This paper introduces a method for rebuilding analytical conjugating surfaces on each tooth of the worm-gear by Bernstein-B’zier interpolating method. Firstly, a family of cross sections, which has the same axis with the worm-gear, is hypothetically applied to intersect with theoretical meshing lines on a worm-gear tooth to generate a sequence of scattered data points. Then, based on all strictly defined boundaries on a tooth, Bernstein-B’zier triangle patches are utilized to interpolate all scattered data points to rebuild the tooth surfaces. During this interpolating processing, an algorithm for smoothing edges of every two adjacent patches is used for obtaining G1 smoothness on whole interpolating surfaces of a tooth. By this way, a 3-D digital model of the worm-gear is constructed and can be used for CNC manufacturing.

articleTitle: Form Follows Function—the evolvement of the tea set
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The key principle of modern product design is ¿form follows function¿. Likewise, form follows function in China traditional design conception too. Through analyzing chinese ancient teaware¿s change impacted by the style of drinking tea, the article accounts for how function impacts on form¿s change.

articleTitle: The application study of universal design principle in the old people product
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: From the concept and background of universal design, this paper introduces the principle of universal design. Based on the actual need analysis of the elderly, it discusses the approach how to design the old age product with the use of the principle of universal design.

articleTitle: Research on the mobile phone design semantics based on the NOKIA products
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the analysis of NOKIA mobile phone products, the concept of mobile phone semantics is drawn from the semantics perspective in this paper. The symbol theory¿s analysis method is applied, and the classification, deconstruction and reconstruction of NOKIA mobile phone semantics is accomplished, and the general phone semantics is concluded from the research result.

articleTitle: Research on the information of product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the fast development of era and the constant progress of social civilization, information plays an important role in product design and affects the whole process of design. To study the information in the process of product design, the novel approaches, questionnaire and semantic differential (SD) method, were employed to investigate the different kinds of information and the different needs between designers. From this study, the model of design information was explored and defined, the usages of information was put forward. And the study of the information also will assist the designers in product design and improve the design management.

articleTitle: Metaphor of interaction design in multimedia information terminals design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Multimedia information terminals have been rapidly developed in recent years, which is a global trend. This paper will introduce the psychological cognitive problems in the design of interactive design in the multimedia information terminals, put forward the phenomenon of metaphor in the interactive design, and develop the method of interaction design through considering the metaphor understanding of users.

articleTitle: Research on improved RBAC model and its access control strategy
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Role based access control (RBAC) is a technology that is attracting increasing attention, particularly for commercial application, because of its potential for reducing the complexity and cost of security administration in large networked application. Nevertheless, there are many deficiencies in the management of user, role and permission, as using the RBAC model in true applications. For instance, when the system gradually expand the scale, the assignment of the user and the assignment of the role¿s efficiency is rapidly decrease; the permission¿s transfer caused by the inheritance of the role, makes the contradictions between the number of role and the granularity of the permission be sharp gradually. In the light of the deficiency of traditional RBAC model¿s access control mechanism, four improved mechanisms are proposed and the improved model¿s access control policy is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on uniform multimode product model based on design tree
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To study the uniform product model (PM) has become one key problem of product development technique for the distributed and collaborative environment. To suite the requirements of unification, integrality and multimode, one integrate product model with three tiers as data tier, logic tier and express tier, based on the product tree technique, is proposed in this paper. This model can satisfy mainly the development of modern advanced manufacture mode.

articleTitle: The management of corporate image design process
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Taking numerous enterprise image design cycle confusion in the present china as a breach, the author proposed that in the enterprise image design, the idea identity system as the command, following MI strictly (mind identity)—BI (behavior identity)—VI (visual identity) design cycle; And further pointed out: In MI, in VI, BI three large-scale system respective construction, should take “the image” as the core, follows the image investigation—image localization—image construction—image dissemination the procedure. Study of the CIS design cycle’s management has certain reference value to design practice.

articleTitle: Discuss on product design factors of ageing society
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: China has entered ageing society. It is very urgent to consider the ageing industry in both theoretical research and design applications. This paper discussed ageing product needed urgently and ageing product design factors considering China¿s national conditions and the needs of elderly person.

articleTitle: Garment conceptual design based on geometry configuration
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The process, to model a garment design system using object-oriented technology based on UML, is introduced in this paper. A new method is applied in developing garment design system, which is called object-oriented UML, different from the traditional flow-based C language method. From core to edge, a screw tape method is used to design the functions of the system with a clear hierarchy, providing a new and recommendable method for garment design. Garment design platform is mainly composed by two modules: the garment selecting module which is based on different human body size and shape; the geometric designing module which is used to design the garments¿ concrete shape.

articleTitle: Design, symbols media and culture sensibilities
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: There is such a words on philosophy: ¿The consciousness can correctly reflect objective world.¿ Because our worlds are the world which is symbolized, that¿s why The mankind realize have the characteristics of the sign turning. The world which is symbolized becomes a world of sensitive faculty because of combined thought culture and emotion.

articleTitle: Return to humanity, reproduce harmony—to analysis the methods of humanity of innovative product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the development in today¿s society, high technology and international design are more and more generally welcomed by peoples. However, some consumers are blindly worship, has led some designers have forgotten the own attribute of products and the fundamental purposes of design and then get into misunderstanding. In order to return product design into human nature and harmony. In this paper, as the core of humanity, analysed some issues existing in innovation product design in 21st century, and for these issues, the paper from several points of emotional design, the design for vulnerable groups and green design of harmonious coexistence between human and nature to discuss how to achieve the humanity of innovative product design, and point out some regularity and tendency of modern innovative product design, to promote the sustainable development of human and nature. I hope it can provide some reference to the development of innovative product design at present.

articleTitle: Study on the design expression of modern product
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The ability of design expression is the necessary skill of an industrial designer. It can help him to produce design inspiration, transmit design ideas and make design communication. The design expression process mainly includes two parts. One is the process of showing the design image from designer¿s ¿invisible¿ ideas to ¿visible¿ form. It shows the designer¿s invisible inspiration and ideas by visible specific form. Another is the process from ¿visible¿ form to audience¿s ¿invisible¿ impression. In this process, the invisible design idea is transmitted to the audiences by visible specific form. The two parts are both independent and linked mutually. They are one dialectical unity. Overall, the whole process of design expression is a circulatory system from ¿invisible¿ to ¿visible¿ and then to ¿invisible¿. In this process, modern industrial designers should pursuit unremittingly that the audience¿s ¿invisible¿ view is consistent with the designer¿s ¿invisible¿ idea by various ¿visible¿ forms.

articleTitle: Creativity roots in life —Thinking about the impact of regional culture on product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Design is more than creating products, its essential purpose is improving people¿s life and guiding people to a correct lifestyle. Lifestyle deeply roots in a regional culture environment which has a great impact on product design. Design creativity roots in our daily life and design innovation is often an innovation of culture. Culture is increasingly being a crucial factor for design innovation. For us, it is getting more and more important to research the impact of regional culture on product design if we want to have our position in the global design market. From the aspects of culture and product design, this paper discusses how to discover the creativity in a certain culture environment and guide people to a civilized and healthy lifestyle.

articleTitle: Industrial design under Chinese economic system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Since China has reformed and opened for more than 20 years, the design has not only obtained the recognition of some communities, but also has already become a huge industry that it does not allow to be neglected. But it exposes many questions, how does the industrial design develop and survive under China special social environment? The Marxism may rescue China, and also may instruct a health vigorous development of China’s industrial design.

articleTitle: Research on the design of fire decision making knowledge base
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To solve the lacking of concept reusing and information sharing problems in fire dispatching decision knowledgebase system, a domain ontology based fire knowledge base model is presented. Fire commanding ontology (FCO) was created to represent domain concepts and the relationship between concepts. FCO was used to construct the semantic description database of information resource in fire dispatching system. The fire domain ontology modeling is discussed. Based on current ontology represent languages, fire commanding ontology represent language (FCORL) is presented. An ontology-based fire decision-making knowledgebase prototype system is constructed. The simulation results show that the model implements concept is reusing and information sharing. At the same time, it improve the level of real-time, accuracy and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Study on a platform for developing virtual prototype of mobile phone
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to improve the market competitiveness of mobile phone manufacture companies in aspects of TQCS, based on the principle of virtual prototyping technology (VPT), a platform for developing the virtual prototype of mobile phone is put forward in this paper. The function model and the architecture of the platform are also described in detail. The ideas and some key technologies for implementing the platform are discussed in this paper. Finally, the validity of the development platform is demonstrated with a design example.

articleTitle: Research on application of advanced manufacturing technology in modern product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper a research on the application of advanced manufacturing technology, including reverse engineering (RE), rapid prototyping (RP) and virtual reality (VR) techniques and so on, in modern product design is developed. Firstly this article tries to analysis the formation and its characters of advanced manufacturing technique nowadays. Then it turns to research on the relations between advanced manufacturing technology and modern product design in subsequent paragraph. Finally it emphasizes on the application of the new technique in modern product design process, such as creation methods, manufacturing process and sales market ways and the relevant areas. In the end we conclude that it¿s possible to shorten product development cycle and realize the design innovation with advanced manufacturing technique.

articleTitle: Application of encrypted data transmission in college office information system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This article discusses the application of encryption technique in college office information system. Guaranteeing integrity of the data and the information in System which has been considered for the particularity of work. An encryption model block is added in college office information system to realize the encrypted transmission of the file which uses the C/S model. Applies end-to-end encryption technology in the office system, increases encryption / decryption mode in the system, sends the encrypted files which the user needs to encrypt the files, this ensures the office automation system security.

articleTitle: The cultural concept of “Beijing Olympics” and semantic component of the elements in traditional Chinese culture
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Traditional culture is the source of cultural connotations of design. Based on the traditional Chinese culture reflected and semantic component adopted in "Beijing Olympics", this paper expounds the connection between traditional cultural elements and modern design, and further more, discusses what modern design should do to enhance cultural connotations by the use of traditional cultural elements, and to realize the inheritance, the development and the renovation of traditional culture.

articleTitle: The research on cooking utensils design of Qin and Han Dynasty and the influence on modern design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: During the period of Qin Dynasty and Han Dynasty, the ancient Chinese cooking design developed more and more mature, the achievement of living utensils design were so great, that there is no historical time can be compared with. The design of cooking utensils received influence from many factors, such as policy, economy, culture, technology and lifestyle, at the same time, it had its own continuous developing rules and characters. With the development of the society, the exterior form and structure of cooking utensils are constantly improved and perfected. As the implement with function base, the idea of usage-oriented was running through the whole design course of cooking utensils. There are also many excellent theories of design contained in ancient cooking utensils, and they can still play an important role in modern design.

articleTitle: Semantic transformation in user interface design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The majority of user interfaces use icons to transmit message. These include software user interfaces, internet multimedia user interfaces, and mobile media user interfaces. An interface designer has to deal with the visualization of information constantly. Semantics is a rhetoric device which has been applied in graphic interface design as an important modeling method. Based on this understanding, the paper probes into the relations between the selection and expression of graphic semantics in interface design.

articleTitle: A case study of China and US industrial design education: Industrial design education in a multicultural world
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A variety of approaches are being used within the Industrial Design Education systems by different countries to meet various challenges being faced in a multicultural world. This paper presents a case study that addresses the undergraduate education methods used by Purdue University, Indiana, USA and Dalian Polytechnic University, Dalian, China. It explains the current education environment through the study of curriculum, course contents, department objectives, intentions and goals. The paper also explores the possible reasons for the Industrial Design education reformation in China and provides an opportunity for the western world to learn about and rethink what Industrial Design education is going on in China.

articleTitle: On universal design methods focusing on environment resources protection
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Adopting sustainable development as the general guiding principle, it analyzes industrial design solutions in eco-society construction; and combining the environment and resources protection issues, it explores the general design concept’s feasibility, advantages and specific patterns of expression in terms of the ageing of the society, effective use of resources, appropriate consumption and enterprise brand strategy, etc. Then focusing on the products fields suitable for universal design and the behavior features of the corresponding population, it studies universal design principles of sharing products for family members, public facilities and recycling in different areas. Through the analysis on the typical cases that universal design models improve efficient use of resources and environment protection, it proposes universal design framework focusing on environmentally friendly principles of long-term use, high quality, functional integration, miniaturization and harmlessness. Thus, the system research of industrial design methodology in sustainable social development and environment protection is enriched.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation system of industrial design based on brand-style feature
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the fierce market competition increasingly, product design pays more attention to the people’s perceptual demands. Brand style has become one of the main factors for consumer to choose product, thus it is important to establish a design evaluation system based on brand style to ensure and enhance design quality. From the idea and method of industrial design, brand-style feature is a collection of common features showed by a series of products. It is the important communicational medium between consumers and designers. Taking people’s perceptual demands as a starting point, this paper analyzed the connotation of brand-style feature and cognitive difference, established the perceptual cognition operation mode and multi-dimensional constitution of brand-style feature, presented a new basic structure of design evaluation system based on brand-style feature, and provided some new idea and method for the evaluation of product design.

articleTitle: The linearization modeling and fuzzy control simulation of GMA
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The conventional linear control method is defective for GMA due to the strong hysteresis nonlinear and hosteresis error. A fuzzy controller is designed based on the linear dynamic model of GMA, taking advantages of good robustness and perfect controlling performance of fuzzy control. Simulation work based on Matlab is given as well. The results reveal that fuzzy controller designed can achieve a good performance with rapid response of the GMA system.

articleTitle: On the application of virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This article introduced the basic contents of the virtual reality technology and its development situation, and showed its synthesis applications in various domains such as the medical service, the building and the military and so on, and it also presented some important flaw. The development of the virtual reality technology will have brought many huge benefits; the life of people will also have taken place enormous changes.

articleTitle: An approach to improve the precision of the grating interferometer measurement
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A grating interferometer may be applied to measure the distance of equipment moving. However, some characteristics and process technics of grating interferometer restrict the measurement precision to get improved. Based on an overall review of model and a method of subdivision and thorough analysis of the factors influencing measurement precision, this paper proposes an approach to improve measurement precision: 160 subdivision of MCS51 single chip micro computer. With the application to grating interferometer, this approach is proved to be more feasible and reliable by table-checking.

articleTitle: Development of a sketching CAD system based on Parasolid
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A sketching CAD system, dubbed Sketch3D, is developed by using Parasolid as the geometric kernel and using OpenGL as the rendering tool under the development environment of Visual C++. It offers a calligraphic interface, which emulates the traditional sketching design approach with paper and pencil, uses the intention capture mechanism to conjecture users’ design intention, and applies the feature-based modeling method to construct 3D solid models. The system supports sketching strokes on the surface of the solid model, and uses the feature joining and cutting mechanism to establish complex solid models. Some main features of Sketch3D are: (1) it supports pen-based input; (2) it applies feature-based modeling method; (3) it can edit 3D models by gestures; (4) it can recognize intelligently the strokes as the basic geometrical entities. This paper first discusses the architecture, the main functions, and the realized methods of Sketch3D. Then some capabilities of Sketch3D have been compared to current CAD systems, such as Pro/E, UG, etc, and with some classical sketching systems, such as SKETCH, Teddy, etc.

articleTitle: On the virtuality of modern arts
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Virtuality is fictionization. Virtuality is not only the characteristic of the plots and contents of the works of contemporary arts, but also acts as the expressive method of the plots. This paper will employ the words virtual and virtualize, and depicts the digital methods and media employed in the contemporary arts and the artistic effects brought by the individual expression in the theme and the contents. The coming of the digital times changes people?s life style and thinking modes. The obvious characteristic of digital times is that it leads us into a real virtual world. The spread of mass culture goes along with the spread of mass media. The television, network and computer altogether constructs the virtual space of the times. The times of mass virtual culture is coming. The cognition and emotions of the artists living in the current times changed potentially. The artists eliminate the class gap between serious arts and popular culture through obtaining fashion, consumption, network, animation, and other popular pictures, and change the traditional artistic expressive methods and bring about new characteristics and changes to the works of arts through the borrowing of the inborn sensitivity of the pictures. This article takes the contemporary drawing works as an example to describe how the artists select the inclined theme and contents, and make use of various digital media and the mass popular culture, and form the virtual plots with Chinese contemporarity and rich imagination by the use of game and metaphor. The contemporary drawing works of art used in this paper, unified with the personal experiences of the artists, reflect the virtual plots of the contemporary drawings through the contents of the works, media method and narrative methods. Every history book of arts repeatedly tell us that the formation of any artistic characteristic reflects the situation of politics and economy of that times, and reflects the special states of mind of the artists in that times. This paper will depicts Chinese characteristics of the virtual plots, and the problems we should confront in the current situation.

articleTitle: An era of Usability Design--perspectives on the realistic significance of “Usability” Design research
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: "Usability" design is not a new topic any more. More than one decade ago, Jakob Nielsen, a "usability" design expert, put forth the theory of "usability" design and applied his theory into practice, which has yielded great accomplishments. Unlike the case in western countries, little attention was attached to this field in China in recent years, or it can be said that not much attention is drawn up to date. As the world goes forward, usability design research becomes extremely significant in the field of the latest design, and the best example is that we often hear of user complaints in the process of accomplishing appointed tasks with a certain product: being unusable, being difficult to use, hard to understand, inconvenient use and inaccessibility for inquisitive information within the fastest term. In the era of ¿user orientation¿, usability design research is of great realistic significance by transforming our thinking and behavior, bringing much convenience to our life.

articleTitle: The application of magnetic materials in fun products
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Magnetic materials are of high percentage of technology with wide applications in various industries and kinds. The product designing of today must not only meet the pragmatic demand of people but also the sentimental demand. Fun products have all the mood factors and designing metaphor meanings, endowing the products with more mental meanings. This paper emphasizes the application of magnetic materials in fun products, discussing the combinations of these two in mental level and designing methods.

articleTitle: Vibrating “mini-washing” washing machine design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper puts forward a whole-new model of washing according to the main problems existed in the current mini-washing machine and ordinary big washing machine. In the meanwhile, it points out another new way of washing—vibrating style, combining the principles of Wheel washing machine and Drum washing machine, the two main kinds of washing machines in the market, and also analyzes its rate of clean washing. This style fuses scrubbing and beating, the two traditional ways of washing, and integrates their advantages as well. It features in high rate of clean washing, water-saving, little damage to clothes, evenly-washing, and no twist and so on.

articleTitle: Researching on parameter-producing automatically on the basis of E-MTM apparel model
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The core technique of apparel E-MTM is generating quickly the personalized pattern. It means that the personalized pattern is came from the type of body information and the designed apparel—model of consumer. Digitizing of apparel model that fashion designers’ works is the premise of producing quickly personalized-pattern. It is also the foundation of realizing E-MTM technique research. Through the standard translating between the pictures of fashion design and the consumer’s type of body, the relationship lies on the body information and the apparel model, the identification model, it forms the determining apparel model by the identification model, the data of shoulder model and ease of three-dimension and hem. According to determining the one-dimension data by the relativity of the body information and apparel model, it will automatically produce the standard parameter of apparel model. The research will lay the solid technique foundation on producing automatically the personalized pattern of E-MTM apparel model.

articleTitle: An integration technology of one domain and cross domain evolution of industrial design knowledge
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In the paper, the expressive forms and the one domain and cross domain evolution technology of industrial design knowledge are presented. The main works are about how to compile the predicates and terms of first order logic (FOL) as the expressive forms, establish the mappings between domains, knowledge parameters ( the predicates and terms) and the knowledge, the correlations between the two knowledge domains in order to navigate cross-domain evolution of the knowledge; recombine gene of coded knowledge in FOL to fulfill one-domain- evolution; integrate the above mentioned technologies. The core principles and the data-flow-chart for an application system fulfilling the works are given.

articleTitle: Study for industrial design based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A prototype for knowledge management platform based on modern information technology is presented. The platform includes network model and function model. The network model of three-layer Browser/Server is introduced in the platform. So designers can simply use browser to acquire knowledge, design and exchange in the different websites. The function model includes four modules as follows: service and management module, design knowledge base module, design and evaluation module, communication and feedback module. And the entire process of industrial design is carried out in the knowledge management platform, which includes concept definition, idea visualization and mass-production. In this process, the exchange and dissemination of knowledge is promoted and the capacity of the knowledge innovation is enhanced. Industrial design based on knowledge management should be considered as one of the main modes in the industrial design field.

articleTitle: The research of virtual human technology in maintainability design of developing weapons and equipment
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Introduce the concept of virtual human, according to the content and requirements of the maintainability, indicate the existing problems in the traditional maintainability design, study the way of maintainability design of weapons and equipment based on the virtual human, the method provide a solution to the problem that people involved in maintenance activities. Design flaws can be found in time and put forward measures to improve. Also provide information to weapons and equipment maintainability design.

articleTitle: Research on clustered patent mapping visualization and interaction
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Patent mapping, which is a series of mapping process with patent information, especially those unstructured information, such as patent claims, details and patent illustrations, is an important tool of patent analysis. Clustering is a popular method to mining the knowledge hidden in patents and provides abundant information to the visualization and interaction of patent mapping. A method of projecting the patents clustering tree along three directions to create tree-shaped patent map, scatter plot patent map and parallel coordinates patent map was proposed. A visualization and interaction structure was also set up based on Flex technology.

articleTitle: Human factor research of voice search on mobile internet
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Voice search is a kind of promising search approach in the era of mobile internet. Currently, most of voice search services are still manual work, which are expected to be replaced by human-machine voice search based on voice recognition technology. Despite numerous disadvantages of human-human voice search, its interaction approach as natural language communication is obviously superior to human-machine voice interaction. In order to get better human-machine voice search interaction scheme, we conduct an investigation into current human-human voice search service with the purpose of understanding human habits and patterns in using voice search, elements that impact user experience, and getting enlightenment for designing automatic voice search interaction. Based on the findings, we continue to explore underlying rules and principles by building models which include two dimension model on search intention, state transition model and user experience hierarchical model. Finally, we propose a blueprint of automatic voice search interaction scheme according to investigation findings and models, hoping it could elicit better design.

articleTitle: The digital and high-precision error detection of complex freeform surface
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The exploitation and modification of automobile die attach great importance to the automobile exploitation. It should be realized in the process of modifying mould—obtaining 3D model by reverse engineering—testing errors—confirming model. This thesis applies the method of ATOS Optical Scanner and CMM (Three-Coordinate Measuring Machine) to obtain the complete high-precision point cloud data because of the complicated free form surface of automobile model. It is difficult to have error evaluation because the CAD model and the point cloud data are impossible to make automatic alignment. Therefore, on the basis of the surface reconstruction of reverse engineering software Imageware and the comparative functions between surface and point cloud data, we propose a new perspective of detecting digital error, i.e. the contour adjustment of surface automatically by the way of golden section method. Under the condition of satisfying the least square method, this method, which can make anastomosis for the actual and theoretical surface, reduces and even eliminates the position error caused by the inconsistency between the actual reference and CAD model reference, laying a foundation to measure shape error by the way of direct alignment method and reducing time as well as improving the error detection precision. Being simplistic, effective and practical, this method has been successfully utilized in the female die design of interior plastic trimming for a certain type of Shanghai Volkswagen car, having great reference value in terms of the automatization, flexibility and digitalization of products on-line detection.

articleTitle: The landscape design research on residential area in Guilin City
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Guilin’s scenery is the best all under heaven, with lots of special characters. This article tries to do landscape design research for city residential area base on scenery view, from the special nature and environment of Guilin city, with modern theories of landscape design, by analyzing and synthesizing natural environment of Guilin.

articleTitle: The Brand Derivative Products’ experience design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, I mainly study for a special product area-Brand Derivative Products. The Brand Derivative Products is a new product area. With the arrival of the experience economy, the behaviors of the production and consumption have changed so that the emergence of the brand derivative products becomes a necessity, also hidden a huge development value. This paper is to explore the inevitability of its emergence and its relationship with the brand from the experience economic view further to explore the principles and areas of developing brand derivative products. And finally discussed the design principles of Brand Derivative Products from the perspective of experience, including in the product design stage, the stage of marketing and communication phase, how to use the knowledge of experience to make Brand Derivative Products design.

articleTitle: Trust management model of cross-domain authorization
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: For the need of authorizing to the unknown agents in cross-domain authorization, this paper designs a trust management model of cross-domain authorization, builds a trust management subsystem to serve the cross-domain authorization management system, to authorize according to the trust degree, focus on solving the management of trust information.

articleTitle: Study on the system ergonomics and environment of digital workshop
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the virtual site of a 3-D digital workshop, a solution scheme of a certain digital factory and the simulation result of the workshop product line, with the support of the ergonomic studies, this paper analyzed the factors that may influence the system ergonomics of the digital workshop from the perspective of work efficiency under human-machine environment. Human, machine and environment of a digital workshop and the interrelationship among them was studied from some aspects including simulation of workshop layout, ergonomics, workshop environment and culture as well as the efficiency of digital workshop. The paper also proposed some basic thoughts and references for workshop environment design based on the studies of workshop material flow and production rules.

articleTitle: Product morphologic semantic and human cognitive habits
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The development of technology brings some problems to the products. Some consumers don’t know the products’ use, they even can’t identify its function. Morphology means something relative with the human’s psychology symbols, therefore, the product positioning shall comply with it so as the complicated message can be easily accepted and understood. The significance of the product morphologic semantic is to change a complex product into a simple image with the help of it. Every product contains many meanings together with different kinds of transmitting message. It is product morphologic semantic that breaks the traditional ergonomics consideration, which is only for the physical and physiological function, and adds psychology, mental factors. As an industry designer, the utmost task is to improve the user’s cognition, shorten the period, study the particular message transmitting way under the application of morphology.

articleTitle: Brief analysis on feminine illustrations
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper describes the reasons for the resurgence of illustration and its status quo, briefly analyzes the diversity of the contemporary illustrations, and highlights the status of feminine illustrations. Moreover, in this paper, by analyzing the representatives of feminine illustrations in different periods, the emergence, picture features and development course of feminine illustrations are studied, and the impact of new media, especially computer, on the creation ways and creation styles of feminine illustrations is also analyzed. Finally, through the analysis on the cases that some contemporary feminine illustrators cooperated with the fashion industry and achieved great success, this paper proves that the combination of feminine illustrations with products can equip products with distinctive artistic personality, thus creating tremendous business value and cultural value and achieving a balance between art and commerce.

articleTitle: Electromagnetism radialization protection in interior design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the increasing electromagnetic radiation of household appliances, the impacts of electromagnetic radiation on the people are larger than before. This paper aims to solve the problems which reducing the electromagnetic radiation at maximum extent by displaying furnitures or plants and using materials in the interior house design. There is big distinction when people displace the household appliances on different directions and locations, furthermore in the interior design the reflections and absorptions of electromagnetic strength in the different decoration materials and broad-leaved plants also have big differences. The reasonable arrangement of the electrical appliances and furnitures can at most prevent human beings from absorbing electromagnetic radiation of household appliances.

articleTitle: A computer-aided product color design system based on color image
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Kansei Engineering is being widely used in the area of industrial design. The color image, as an important part of the Kansei Engineering, is one of the key factors which can affect the customer¿s image perception apart from the shape of the product. The study of the color image in Kansei Engineering learning was carried out based on the medical treatment equipment, through the network, especially by using the customization technology based on the cult 3d and the asp.net, so it conquers the shortcoming of the traditional method in color image getting, shorting the investigating time, scaling the swatch. The result of the study shows that the method can get all the expecting items, and can finally improve the actual effect and accuracy of the color image learning.

articleTitle: Metal parts injection molding CAD/CAE and concurrent development system integration
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: There is no professional injection simulation software in metal powder injection industry, so we propose to establish shrinkage rate formula for different materials and sintering temperature. On the basis of large number of experiments and data analysis, we have been verified the correctness of the formula. We have finished the design of injection mold by UG MoldWizard modules, and realized simulation and analysis of injection process with MoldFlow software. Through the mould concurrent development process, it has completed the CAD / CAE integration of the mould, and achieved the optimal design of the mould, which wil greatly improve the development efficiency of the mould.

articleTitle: Investigation and realization of refactoriable BSP
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional BSP, this paper designed a sort of refactoriable BSP which is modularized and layered, and the BSP developing efficiency is advanced, and the developing difficulties is reduced, and it is explained and validated by the instances of the project.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of particle impacting on substrate in low temperature and high velocity oxygen/air fuel spraying process
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The impact behavior of spraying copper particle on substrate in low temperature and high velocity oxygen/air fuel(LT-HVO/AF) spraying process is studied by using the method of finite element Lagrange analysis, analyzing the relation of particle velocity, deformation behavior and temperature. It is found that impact velocity directly influences the entire impact process and confirmed that there is the critical velocity for particle deposition and adiabatic shear instability of particle which is about 550m/s and 650m/s. As the particle velocity rises, the particle deformation, particle temperature and contact area of particle and substrate increase all increases. When the particle velocity achieves 800m/s, the highest temperature at the interface with particle and substrate achieves or up to the melting point of particle which leads to the metallurgical bonding of the particle with the substrate.

articleTitle: A Comparison between piano composition Mei Hua San Nong and qin qu Mei Hua San Nong-analysis of ethnic musical characteristic of piano composition Mei Hua San Nong
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
