abstract: Through the comparative study between piano composition Mei Hua San Nong and qin qu Mei Hua San Nong, an inquiry into the ethnic musical characteristic of piano composition Mei Hua San Nong is made; thus this may assist performers in comprehending piano composition Mei Hua San Nong’s technique, art treatment, style, etc, and also in performing well with a characteristic of Chinese musical style.

articleTitle: Research on the design of VRML-based circuit experiment
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Experiment teaching plays an important role in remote education. It is helpful for the cultivation of students¿ manipulating ability, analyzing ability and problem-solving ability. Furthermore, experiment teaching plays a critical role in cultivation of students¿ innovation awareness and capacity. Virtual reality has advantages such as intuition, capacity to repeat, low-input and high-efficiency. It has received great attention in experiment teaching. In this paper, the principles and the technologies of EAI and VRML used to carry out remote virtual experiment are firstly discussed. Secondly, design of virtual circuit experiment system based on B/S structure is demonstrated. Thirdly, how to use Servlet to make up for the deficiencies of Applet so as to make it easier to access the database is discussed. Finally, circuit experiment in secondary schools is taken for example to testify the feasibility of the virtual experiment system. The example shows that virtual experiment is easy, efficient and intuitive. It is suitable for simulating operation of apparatus in science and engineering teaching. Virtual experiment, which needs a few hardware and software resources, is the best choice among simulation technologies. It is of high application value as well.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation for pipe forming in multi-process hot extrusion
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The numerical simulation method that pipe material forming in multi-process hot extrusion was researched by FEM software ANSYS-LSDYNA. In the paper the craft parameters, such as friction, temperature, extrusion speed and the heat up length of the pipe, which affected the effect of extrusion were analyzed and will provided theory reference when hot extrusion craft were established.

articleTitle: Study of CAID software user interface design based on usability
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The quality of CAID software influences the industrial designer¿s work status and efficiency directly. Besides the technology performance of software, the good user experience is closely bound up with the software user interface in software quality evaluation. This article analyzes and studies the user interface design of CAID software based on usability. By choosing the user group of the CAID software, requirement analysis, and multi-angle evaluation and analysis to the frequently used part, GUI of typical software such as Cinema 4D, Imagestudio against usability, the usability principle and design thinking to the CAID software user interface design come up according to the research and analyzed result. In the end, focusing on the CAID software development status and combined with the usability principle, this article forecasts the development trend of the CAID software user interface.

articleTitle: Post Planned Obsolescence
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: How to extend product life circle through innovative design is the responsibility of designer. Through analyzing the reasonable content in ¿Planned Obsolescence¿ and the series design of Ricoh R digital camera, the author bring forward to the product series design model of ¿post planned obsolescence¿. The author points that feature is the core of the model, and technology, function and appearance are the basic elements of product series design in this model. Through flexibly use of these three aspects design, we could gradually and reasonably upgrade the product in order to extend its life cycle and then help enterprise and society to create more wealth.

articleTitle: Aesthetics construction of the product information
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays the culture and society revolutions made by information technology exert great influence on every aspect of the product information. Facing the complex kinds of products of today, no study of information aesthetic conception, no advancement on the field of creation of product design. This paper draws to the basic principle of Aesthetics, Information technology and other disciplines, and study the current development trends in product design, and analysis the aesthetic value and application value of the contemporary product information, and analysis and describe a number of fairly representative of the current works. And also this paper interprets the product information of the expression methods, construct process and other problems. Finally, it exemplifies how to design products through information and how to express information in product designing.

articleTitle: Realistic simulation of multi-scale fluid-solid coupling
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel method for simulating middle- and small-scale details of incompressible viscous fluids and solid coupling. To animate the fluid model, we use the Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) method, which models the flow as a particle system in middle-scale, and based on it, we focus on the interaction between water and solid surface, especially the effects of absorption and adhesion. The absorption is simulated by absorption equations, which are mainly controlled by absorption, absorptivity, and saturation; and the adhesion is simulated by a linear spring and dashpot model, which can simulate the adhesive force. The proposed method works here to realistically animate the water gradually penetrating into the solid object, as well as some movements of runoff and flashing water. This new method thus improves existing fluid simulations, making them capable of generating new kinds of multi-scale interactions which have not realized in the present researches.

articleTitle: Path analysis of the promotion of design to creative industries
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Creative industry has become a necessary choice when social economy develops to a certain phase. It represents the future trend of newly-rising industries with knowledge economy, consumption culture and innovation theory as background. China’s creative industries, though still in the preparation phase and starting late, but with a higher start and faster movement, have become new growing hot spots in the national economy. Design can be defined as creative activities with specific purpose. The core of creative industry is innovation. So they are the same in nature. In this paper, from designing point of view and through the research of design nature and law of development, the author, starting with artistic design which is closely related to the creative industries, identifies the common nature of artistic design and creative industry, so as to extend and find out a promoting path of creative industries, and also to figure out the virtuous cycle enabling complementary and common development. In addition, the author wants to show the practical meaning of inclusion and coordination of the two through detailed examples and accurate data. Development of art and design is promoting the development of creative industries, and vise versa. Using references from current design promotion, combined with current development status, it will of great help to find out the path to development of creative industries with Chinese characteristics that adapt to China’s current development situation and fundamental realities.

articleTitle: The research on the cost of interacting with products
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper brings forward a new interactive mode, thus educes the new concept of interactive cost, and its definition is made on the basis of systematical research on interaction, interactive design and interactive mode. Interactive cost is the value one has to pay for their needs when interacting with products. Interactive costs include time costs, psychology cost, opportunity cost, and the possible money cost. Examples show that interactive cost is one of the important factors which affect people when choosing products. So, studies on the interactive cost have certain guiding significance to the interactive design of products.

articleTitle: The study and heritage of traditional culture in modern design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, with the increasing development in science and technology, modern design industry jump into the view and make its foundation on commercialization of large-scale production. In China, some of the modern design blindly follow the fashion, personality, and the westism, with the consideration that abroad new ideas and new concepts have brought unprecedented impact on traditional Chinese culture and art. However, the traditional culture in both form and content angles is still a rich soil to modern design. Therefore, chinese design industry, with a profound cultural accumulation, should not abandon the traditional culture. Instead, modern designers in China should be built on the base of traditional culture, and find their teacher of the design style, the production process, the selection of materials, and others from traditional culture, and only then could they do more than students. A successful modern design should embrace both ancient and modern, listen to others voice, open mind for different culture, and finally and most importantly is the reflection of the harmony between man and nature with modern way. It is not just learning and transferring of the traditional Chinese culture, but also developing and promoting Chinese modern design to the worldwide.

articleTitle: Product conceptual design based on the idea of sustainable design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The statement of sustainable design transcends original idea of product design, and has new requirements of the process of product design and impact on environment. Product conceptual design is the core of product innovation. And conceptual development of products and design of products decisively influence product detailed design, product manufacturing development, product market development as well as the realization of enterprises’ business strategic goal in the process of product innovation. This article mainly elaborate the importance of following the idea of sustainable design from design connotations, design principles and design purpose of product conceptual design, thus able to shorten the disparity of conceptual design and changes in the market, so that conceptual products made by product conceptual design can be a great degree of putting on the market and be successful.

articleTitle: Fast degree elevation approach for cubic B-spline curve
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In computer aided geometric design, B-spline is an important method for curve and surface modeling, and it is widely used in many applications. For B-spline modeling, we usually need to deal with its elevation in order to keep the same degree between B-spline curves or surfaces with different degrees. Many papers have paid more attention on this problem, and some important results were obtained. But, it is not completely solved by now. In this paper, we present a new approach to elevate cubic B-spline curve, which is based on the relationship matrix between cubic B-spline bases and quartic B-spline bases on each knot segment within the domain of B-spline curve. For this approach, the new control points can be obtained directly for each knot segment. Actually, this method has lower computation, and easily implements.

articleTitle: The recognition of the importance of comprehensive modeling
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Comprehensive modeling is a primary course to cultivate students¿ design cognition and their ability of three dimensional modeling. With the development of modern designing and teaching, many universities have actively engaged themselves in the exploration and reformation of this course, and have gained quite a lot experience. Putting at the beginning of the new term, comprehensive modeling gives the students a systematic and all-round understanding of designing, especially the classifying of designing at its fundamental sense. With the design cognition as the essential element of cultivation, restriction is the basic requirement for design and also the starting point of finding the breakthrough. Only after the students have formed independent and mature design cognition and the regular pattern of modeling through practicing can they gain a solid background for the product design for their further study.

articleTitle: The design studies of green earthen ceramic glaze column Dou-shaped lamp
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Dou-shaped lamp originates from the evolution of living vessel which have simple shapes, is convenient to be used and has a long history. It has played an important role in the history of Chinese lamp development. This paper takes green earthen ceramic glaze column Dou-shaped lamp as an example to summarize the evolvement, development and innovation of the Dou-shaped lamp. Prospective study and practicability of the Dou-shaped lamp are appraised objectively from the aspects of the morphological analysis, elements analysis, material technics analysis and culture analysis etc. with means in design. Sustainable development concept of the modern design is discussed from the rational application of resources in Dou-shaped lamp design process, which is the externalization of the harmonious coexistence design thought.

articleTitle: Real 2D presentation of spatial solids and real presentation rate with fuzzy pattern recognition II—methods and visualization
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The axonometric drawing is one of the 3-D object presentations with 2-D. For the coordinate measuring view, fuzzy pattern recognition is utilized, providing the concrete methods and visualized steps for evaluation and determination of the real presentation, analyzing the real presentation rates for the axonometric drawing. Results show that for non-concave solids, the usual solution with ¿real 2-D presentation¿ is the normal trimetric drawing. However, on special occasions, the normal trimetric drawing is not the desired design. For more common situations, it is convenient and efficient to employ the fuzzy pattern recognition put forward by the author to determine the presenting angle and the real presentation rate.

articleTitle: Analysis on the colors of clothing in Beijing Olympics
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The athletes¿ clothes of all nations in Beijing Olympics are impressive. In this paper, starting from the description about the national colors of the national flags, the colors of clothing of various delegations are discussed. The wide use of Chinese elements in the Olympics clothes has been a bright spot. The success or failure of the colors used in Chinese delegation is analyzed, and conclusion is drawn in the end of this paper.

articleTitle: The realization of campus emulation system based on OpenGL and 3D
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Scientific visualization, computer animation and virtual reality are the three main active developing trend in the field of computer graphics recently, the kernel technology of which are all 3D graphics with sense of reality. This thesis introduces the realization of campus emulation system based on OpenGL and 3D in details in the environment of VC++.

articleTitle: Landscape design of urban waterfront
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Derived from the glorious Chinese water culture, this article aims to discuss the relationship between urban and the water environment. Based on modern landscape design theory, this article analyze the prominent problems existing in the domestic urban shore water landscape, studies positively the urban shore water landscape that suits the Chinese culture, attempts to summarize the urban shore water landscape design method that can ecologically maintain the regional culture.

articleTitle: Design of the lifting mechanism with virtual prototyping technology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In the traditional design process, the design method of port machines mainly adopts the static design and has no effective dynamic technique. The technique of virtual prototype can factually simulate all kinds of running states of each mechanism under various working conditions which vary from different loads and in all kinds of processes. The results of the emulation are used for estimating and judging the data of actual movement. It also offers certain value for reference for the dynamic analysis and the calculation of port machinery, and provides technical support for the creative design and the optimization of crane, and plays an important part in expediting the development cycle and reducing the cost. ADAMS is a famous virtual prototyping modeling and analysis software. This paper introduces the application of the virtual prototyping technology based on ADAMS software which is used in the research process of the lifting mechanism of the gantry crane. The related dynamics models were established and the dynamics loads were conformed under different working conditions according to crane dynamics theories. Interrelated data, which is got in the simulation analyses, offers effective methods on dynamic design of integrated system of the lifting mechanism. It will shorten the design period of the gantry crane and will improve the efficiency and the quality of the design. The virtual prototype study on integrating system of the lifting mechanism leads to an efficient tool and a method for designing gantry crane which is economic, credible, stable and high-powered. This design method will be extensively applied in mechanism design.

articleTitle: Science and technology inspire the creativity of architecture design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the development of science and technology, nowadays one can find their figures nearly in every aspects of our life. So does the realm of architecture. Actually, since ancient years many an architect derived inspiration and abstracted aesthetic regulations from geometry, creating splendid architecture works known to us all. In addition, they also learn form nature and apply the theory of bionics and the achievements in mechanics to create new structure system. Today, more and more architects make use of 3D computer modeling and simulation technique to complete complicated shapes in architecture design. All above indicates to us that there is no separateness between science and art in the development of architecture. This paper is trying to discuss several different aspects in architecture that shows the union of science and art and to analyze mutual influence between technology improvement and architectural art. Thus one can realize how science and technology bring about enormous inspiration and advancement to architecture design and create unique and vivid building image.

articleTitle: Redesign of leaf surface measuring apparatus based on ergonomics research
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The leaf surface measuring apparatus is used to quickly measure the area of live leaf of plant. Though the LSM apparatus has been very much promoted for its technical factors, it has many deficiencies for its appearance and form. Those deficiencies limit its effective applications and incur many complaints from the users. The interface design is basically based on ergonomics research of LSM apparatus. First the operation of the LSM apparatus is carefully analyzed, the weight of the LSM apparatus is found to be the main problem; Second the characteristics of hand are researched; Third the similar apparatus is compared. Through the ergonomic research, new LSM apparatus is redesigned.

articleTitle: Application of method in psychology design for example MP3 design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper made a cognizant psychology study of the MP3 user’s psychological esthesis, behavior and emotion, etc, by the case of designing MP3 and the design investigation method brought forward with psychology design. Then it gave the new taking fashion of MP3 and proved the reasonable use of psychological design investigation in the process of product design.

articleTitle: Study on computed aided product decorative design and its evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Computer Aided product decorative design is one of the significant branches of CAID. The way of expression in the former cases was limited by many conditions, which resulted in prolonged design cycle and low efficiency. This paper started with the aim of satisfying the demands of clients, offered a solution and procedure for solving complicated, multi-solution cases, for problems including prolonged design cycle, modification of cases, evaluation and decision-making with the purpose of obtaining the decorative design scheme which will satisfy the clients to the highest degree. Meanwhile the paper set the target of evaluation of computer aided product decorative design and illustrated the eventual satisfactory evaluation result with examples of certain products.

articleTitle: The community cooperation system based on the universal design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The author first introduces the concept of the community cooperation system, by analyzing the results of the study, explains the background of the system establishment. With the problem how to establish the system, the author introduces the universal design, describes that the system should be designed based on the seven principles of universal design. Finally, the author makes some attempts based on universal design principles.

articleTitle: Co-management of brand identity and customer experiences
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The traditional goods-dominant logic of marketing is under challenge and leading researchers are now emphasizing the new service-dominant logic. Evolving to a new dominant logic for marketing. One of the key foundational propositions of this logic is the customer as “always being a co-creator of value” where “the brand becomes the experience. The co-management of value. In this paper, we examine the concept of brand relationship experience in the context of co-creation and service-dominant logic and outline a conceptual model for designing and managing the customer experience. Case study research illustrates how this model helps in the design and management of the brand relationship experience for an innovative new product.

articleTitle: Decorative rejuvenation — aesthetic analysis of “Memphis” design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, in the developing outline and context of contemporary design, ¿Memphis¿ design groups seemed to be a flash in the sky. However, as part of post-modernist design ideas, ¿Memphis¿ production, development and conversion have brought the designer of the new century a deep insight. ¿Memphis¿ gave the design to the world of fresh air, some people criticize the ¿Memphis¿ grade also received some inspiration. Some critics also learned a lot. ¿Memphis¿ products have strong anti-modern design concept. They clearly show their attitude to the modern design. Then, Its decoration style has become an important content of international post-modernist culture. Although the process of development is limited, but ¿Memphis¿ still affect the world design.

articleTitle: Song of the soul with free and easy freedom - talk about the song of original works of music of Chinese network
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Network original works of music song is a new force on music circles a dark horse in China, it spreads in the society and prevails greatly at the speed of exploding through modern network media and technology. Compared with traditional song, all there are their one’s own characteristics in view of its artistic style and propagating the way in the song of original works of music of network, and has exerted an important influence on the traditional song. This test has analysed current situations of the development, artistic characteristics of the song of original works of music of network with this stationery body,pointed out its impact and influence to the thing that contemporary Chinese music and social life bring, and has carried on the preliminary discussion to some concrete problems that it met

articleTitle: Conditions of proper sculptured surface machining on polar coordinates
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Multi-axis machining of sculptured surfaces is in wide use in Conventional and Rapid Prototyping. Topic of the paper is in the area of sculptured surface machining on polar coordinates. The problem under consideration is: How to define and how to analytically describe a set of necessary and sufficient conditions of proper SSM. The similar problem is already solved with respect to machining of sculptured surface by Stephen P. Radzevich . Here this problem is enhanced up to the area of machining of sculptured surface on Polar coordinates NC machine. The general approach to solve the problem is developed. The input data to the approach presented later is a complete information of topology of a sculptured surface to be machined on polar coordinates and of the machining surface of a form cutting tool to be applied. The set of six necessary and sufficient conditions of proper SSM is developed as a result. This set of analytically described conditions can be considered as a sort of restrictions on the geometrical and kinematical parameters of a machining operation. The methodology presented here is a general one. It combines the activities of exploration of topology of a given sculptured surface, of the machining surfaces of a form cutting tool, and of kinematics of relatives motion of these surfaces in machining operation, thus making the production process for conventional and rapid prototyping flexible, automatic and controllable.

articleTitle: On the virtuality of modern arts
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Virtuality is fictionization. Virtuality is not only the characteristic of the plots and contents of the works of contemporary arts, but also acts as the expressive method of the plots. This paper will employ the words virtual and virtualize, and depicts the digital methods and media employed in the contemporary arts and the artistic effects brought by the individual expression in the theme and the contents. The coming of the digital times changes people’s life style and thinking modes. The obvious characteristic of digital times is that it leads us into a real virtual world. The spread of mass culture goes along with the spread of mass media. The television, network and computer altogether constructs the virtual space of the times. The times of mass virtual culture is coming. The cognition and emotions of the artists living in the current times changed potentially. The artists eliminate the class gap between serious arts and popular culture through obtaining fashion, consumption, network, animation, and other popular pictures, and change the traditional artistic expressive methods and bring about new characteristics and changes to the works of arts through the borrowing of the inborn sensitivity of the pictures. This article takes the contemporary drawing works as an example to describe how the artists select the inclined theme and contents, and make use of various digital media and the mass popular culture, and form the virtual plots with Chinese contemporarity and rich imagination by the use of game and metaphor. The contemporary drawing works of art used in this paper, unified with the personal experiences of the artists, reflect the virtual plots of the contemporary drawings through the contents of the works, media method and narrative methods. Every history book of arts repeatedly tell us that the formation of any artistic characteristic reflects the situation of politics and economy of that times, and reflects the special states of mind of the artists in that times. This paper will depicts Chinese characteristics of the virtual plots, and the problems we should confront in the current situation.

articleTitle: Study of global parameters optimization of large caliber sniper rifle based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Large caliber sniper must satisfy several design requirements such as firing accuracy, reliability, weight limit and so on. How to get optimized structure parameters of large caliber sniper is a key target of designers. Global parameters optimization of large caliber sniper rifle based on genetic algorithm was studied in this paper. Firing accuracy was chosen as object function of global parameters optimization. Simulation model of firing accuracy was established firstly. Neural network method was used to fit object function. Genetic algorithm was used to search optimized structure parameters of whole rifle. A group of optimized structure parameters were got finally. The large caliber sniper rifle with these parameters has balanced performance according test. The study of this paper can offer a method for choosing better structure parameters of large caliber sniper rifle. Also the study can improve design efficiency.

articleTitle: On digital protective system of China tradition dermatoglyphic pattern
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The Chinese traditional totem, which is our national cultural treasure, including special artistic style and national language expresses the people’s great will; it communicates with our soul through the artist’s hands, and all these compose the specialty of Chinese traditional culture. In this thesis we research on construction of digital protection system and referring to the successful expressive skills of multimedia, meanwhile, propose some new expressive measures and idea in order to discuss how we protect Chinese traditional totem which is so-called “tangible image” in digital level, so make the treasure exist forever.

articleTitle: Study on development tendency of product design rendering
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The goal of the product design rendering is to express design concepts and creative ideas through the reasonable recurrence of product shape, color and material quality as well as the description of product function, usability and etc. The designs are often represented by the real or hand-pained object, or being aided by computer or the above all. However, with the development of information technology and changing of people¿s social cognition, traditional design rendering is inevitably undergoing a profound transformation. Although the general tendency is the vision extension in multi-dimensional space, the design rendering has practically evolved into two completely different methods: (1) an independent and complex communication employed by a designer during conceptual development; (2) a mutual communication with multiple perspectives employed during discussion on proposed project. In this article the authors tried to systematically discuss these two methods from both conceptual and technical perspectives, and summarized some experiences obtained during the design practice.

articleTitle: The inheritance of minority art elements in Chinese designs
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Being one of Chinese traditional art, the minority art has been distinguished as its unique culture appeal and national characteristics. With the gradual evolvement of the decorative patterns, minority art has become nationality representative in some extent. To inherit those unfailing soul of nationality culture could also carry forward the Chinese traditional culture. Those representative elements of the minority art can be boldly employed in contemporary designs, which may result in its’ own increasingly perfecting along with improvement of Chinese designs. We could realize the application in product designs, visual communication, architecture, costume designs as well as artware, so that, the elements of minority art can be inherited in Chinese design.

articleTitle: Designs become veritable, when they meet human’s needs -Of the relationship between designs and customers’ using habit
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of the designs and customers’ using habit which compose a contradictory unity. They influence and restrain each other. It’s beneficial for us to figure out the causal relationship so that we could arm ourselves with correct notions of design and using and set up the direction for culture as well. By answering the call for a innovative way to inherit traditions and national culture and holding a macro world outlook composed by pursuits of health, harmony and individuality, the difficulty to treat customers’ using habits dialectically is no longer in the way of creative designing. How to analyze rationally, how to design reasonably and how to facilitate customers to develop proper habits will be mainstream of design activities and innovations. And only in this way does it deserve the name, “the concept of human-oriented design”.

articleTitle: Computer aided evaluating system based on fuzzy set for garment quality
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Aiming at the problem that manual grading for garment fabric’s quality has not good precision, this paper presents a new method based on fuzzy set which can evaluate the quality grade of the garment fabric. According to fuzzy theory, we firstly construct a fuzzy matrix from existed fuzzy sets which can evaluate the garment fabric’s quality. According to this matrix, we put forth improved closeness formula which can more accurately grade garment fabric than traditional closeness formula. At the same time, nearness principle which can decide the last grade result of garment fabric is applied. According above method, flow chart of computer aid evaluating system based on this matrix module for garment fabric is proposed and an example is provided to validate that this method is correct. At last, the matrix features, veracity of the way, application range of closeness formula and influences on production are analyzed.

articleTitle: Fundamental characteristics of being an artist
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the rapid development of the material world, people nowadays have a greater longing for the spiritual world. Art, as a product of social activity, has demonstrated the social activity itself and the aesthetic form of artists¿ thoughts and feelings by means of certain forms of matter and emotion, with art advancing along the society and changing along people¿s aesthetic ideals. Artists are the main creator of arts. While many factors have constituted the main body of creation which also has been changing with the development of society, there is one crucial element that has never changed -the fundamental characteristics of being an artist. The paper discusses the very element, expecting to be served as a way of exchanging and learning from contemporary art workers, and hoping to be of help to the development of contemporary art.

articleTitle: The Research of Crack Forecast for Casting Slab based neural network
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Aimed at the feature and crafts condition of continuous casting, this paper combined with the prevent countermeasure of board in some national and foreign advance iron and steel plants, adopt with the model of illegibility nerve network base on subtraction clustering, study the formatting reasons of board crack and put up forecasting.

articleTitle: Influence Of environmental arts upon the public environment consciousness
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Environmental art arise with the public environmental awareness caused by industrialization. Based on natural environment, it perfects our living spaces by using all kinds of technical and artistic methods. It creates artistic human settlement environment and emphasizes the harmonies between human development and the environmental resource. The public environmental awareness is influenced by the environmental art on environmental aesthetic sense, ecological concepts and environmental behavior.

articleTitle: Non-stable form using in environmental art design from the view of Gestalt aesthetics
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This article discusses the application of non-stable in contemporary environmental art design from the perspective of Gestalt aesthetics. Gestalt aesthetics has a unique interpretation about the aesthetic effect of ¿non-stable form¿. Experiments show that, in the face of a simple form, people will feel very comfortable and calm, they will not block the perception activities, and they will not create any tension and other bad feelings. We call such form is ¿beautiful¿ or ¿stable ¿forms, at the same time, those non-symmetrical, tilted, irregular forms will lead people to psychological tension and a feeling of excitement, we generally call such irregular and disorderly forms the ¿ugly¿ or ¿non-stable¿ forms. However, the fun in this - first aroused the attention and tension, followed by its active organizations, and finally the organizations activities to be completed and early tensions disappear. The experience of this course is no longer a straight dull, it is ups and downs. Gestalt aesthetics can help us understand the use of non-stable form in environmental art design the perspective of theoretical level, and guide our design practice.

articleTitle: The research on the purposes, principles and methods of Chinese characters design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Chinese characters is a miracle of world’s characters forests because of it’s complex and changeable structure of the combination of strokes unique shape and the long history cultural heritage. It is a physical forms and information dissemination carrier of Chinese cultural values, retains the aesthetic concepts of the Chinese nation. But the fast-paced and the fierce competition in the modern society make enterprises and other social organizations to aware of the importance of brands, which requires the designer must keep the innovative image design. In case want to change this situation, designers must recognize the purposes and principles of Chinese characters, which is based from the people-centered design principles, multi-dimensional and multi-facet research on a deeper level of characters structure and principle and other font-related information can get some design methods and convey methods with practical value and significance.

articleTitle: Exceeding TONG and HE -- A study about unification and diversification of modern design on different levels
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: It is no doubt that modern design needs to be more humanistic and more emotional. But it seems to be a conflict in modern design: on one side, globalization makes it more unified; on the other side, the consumers need diversification of design. Modern design should be more unified or diversified? People tried to solve the problem by the thought of HE but not TONG said by Confucius, but the real relationship of HE and TONG is also a problem. In fact, it is not conflictive between the unification and diversification of modern design if it is discussed on different levels. In this paper, the author discussed the three levels of modern design through an Asian food culture research case named Chopsticks. And the conclusion is that in the information age, modern design is basing on a unified order on technology level, being formed in diversified cultures on aesthetic level, and developing toward the kernel value of ‘people centered’ on ethic level.

articleTitle: The match of implementation model and mental model in interactive design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In recent 10 years, with the development of science and technology, the Internet is also getting more and more popular in China. The request to computer’s software also is enhanced. People not only use the computer to complete the work mission simply, but they also propose that the computers are more, higher user-friendly: The computer should have function foundation, but also be able to raise people’s efficiency and eliminate the work confusion, so the software could serve the user more friendly. It is important that the designer should realize the match of the implementation model and the mental model in product development and design.

articleTitle: Research on human body templates automatic generating system based on AutoCAD
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To generate human body templates automatically is very useful for analyzing and defining the position relationship between man and machine. Based on AutoCAD, this article introduces the design thoughts and the functional features of human body templates automatic generating system, explains the key problem the system solves, and supplies a solution for interactive adjustment of the human body templates.

articleTitle: Integrated Creative Platform (ICP)™: Strategic innovation for China’s creative cultural industries
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This essay seeks to propose designing a platform to integrate the strengths of China’s creative, cultural, manufacturing industries, as well as the R&D and design education sector, so as to stimulate business innovation in a city or region, and ultimately benefitting its economic growth. It analyzes the current issues which those sectors are facing, then proposes a conceptual framework on utilizing the existing creative cultural parks / experimental zones in China to facilitate that growth. This framework could serve as a blueprint for policy makers in the government and operators of creative cultural parks for implementation.

articleTitle: Technological sheet region recognition of garment piece on sweater CAD
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, a new computer pattern recognition method based on fuzzy cluster theory is presented. Firstly, node of piece figure date structure is found using “directional judgment method”. The random pieces are classified to garment pieces, sleeve pieces, trousers pieces and so on using fuzzy theory, thus the pieces of sweater have an appropriate classifying to fit calculation of technological sheet. We also put forward knot mapping method which can divide a sweater piece into many of symmetry region which is named to Technological Sheet Calculating Region (TSCR), computer system can confirm final TSRCs according precision requirement of technological sheet. Finally, technological sheet of TSRCs which is recognized by computer is calculated by dimension of top and bottom border. Application of sweater CAD demonstrates this method can calculate rapidly the technological sheet of sweater pieces.

articleTitle: The internationalization of modern Chinese cartoon
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Chinese cartoon in its initial stage was greatly commented for its colorful themes and artistic exhibition techniques. However, American and Japanese cartoons gradually take up dominant position with their originality and perfect market operating pattern in subsequent fierce international market competition. Only if Chinese cartoon drastically innovates in its creation concept, imagination and industrialization operating will it integrate itself into new orbit of international cartoon. Cartoon art is a kind of cosmopolitan culture, when Chinese cartoon borrows foreign experience, it should also keep the national characteristics of China.

articleTitle: Experiential design based on the area of cultural and creative industries
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the global trend of experiential economy, cultural and creative industries are upgraded an unprecedented level. From the government to individuals, from designers to entrepreneurs, from colleges and universities to institutes of scientific research, all of them are aware of the tremendous value of cultural and creative industries. At present, as an important branch of cultural creative industries, design considers more shopping experience of consumers rather than basic function of produces. Actually, consumer’s purchase behavior is the process of the inner experience and enjoy. The paper analyses the background and traits of experiential design from the perspective of cultural creative industries, and illustrates specific applications in five aspects of sensory experience design, emotional experience design, interactive experience design, specific experience design and narrative experience design. The purpose is to research realistic significance of experiential design towards contemporary design in China, and to strive to build Chinese-style experience design, finally to enhance the position of design in the cultural and creative industries in China.

articleTitle: Analysis on a microwave oven based on user operation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, considering the features of the microwave oven, we chose interview and non-participate observation as main research methods to analyze the product from user operation viewpoint. After questionnaire and discussion, we decided the main areas of the research and divided them into four parts. They were semantics, safety, ergonomics and function. We designed three tasks to let nine participants fulfill one by one, which would reflect the problems as many as possible that the users could meet. Finally, we got the conclusions statistically through observation and analysis on the questionnaires. This microwave oven has the severe problem in Semantic area. In safety area there is no big problem. In Ergonomic area, there are something need to be improved about door and interior surface, for the cleaning and food taking reasons.

articleTitle: Brief analysis color structure of cartoon movies
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In animation, color in with movie narrative structure, character’s emotion and destiny as well as in its element union of the Audio-visual language, forms the animation color the structure and the rhythm, unfolds its visual melody by this. Not only this time the color is the pure film and television modeling method, but also must constitute the movie visual language shape. It manifests the movie color the performance and the symbolic significance. It causes the color fusion in the movie dramatic work, forms the silver screen color the dramatic work structure. It causes form itself to become the content, not only but is isolated signifying refers.

articleTitle: On delivery of applicable messages of products for aged people
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With their physical and psychological functions failing, aged people would encounter many obstacles that make their life tougher. Therefore, it is especially important to show care and concern about aged people while providing products for them. Such care and concern should be performed by increasing the convenience of operation of such products, and increasing the products’ relation to aged people so as to build a tighter connection between aged people and the world. The above mentioned convenience of operation is mainly measured by delivery of applicable messages of the products. The paper deals with delivering brief messages for easier operation of the products by aged people and increase the emotional relation between aged people and the products for them and how to do that by visual, audio, and tactile.

articleTitle: Exploring Computer Aided Color Design of architecture surroundings based on tone harmonizing
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on industrial design theory and modern design methodology, this paper proposes a comprehensive strategy for architecture exterior color design according to the analysis of the current status and trend of existing color design tools. On the basis of three-dimensional color theory, this paper brings forward a scheme for color matching process of hue reconcilement, and develops a hue reconcilement tool based on architecture exterior color design according to the comparison of new and old schemes of configuration. This paper brings “hue reconcilement” theory in color configuration into the process of architecture exterior color design for the first time, and emphasizes the coordinating role of hue in the whole environment. In the process of realizing the hue reconcilement tool, special color selection is finished by constructing a exclusive-used color space. Then designer can modify color parameters according to architecture color card and identify color scheme after incorporating the effect of environmental factors as well as analogy and optimization of choosing and matching colors. This paper uses a research method which combines analysis, analogy and application of verification; takes into account factors such as color space attribute, color coordination effect, hue type compartmentalization and texture and lighting effect; further optimizes the method for architecture exterior color design; and finally improves the efficiency of design greatly.

articleTitle: Application of modern new materials in product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Material technology is one of the most important fields in the development of science technology. With the development of science technology, new materials appear and are widely used all over the world, and they give tremendous impetus to product design. At first, the paper describes how these new materials affect the product design. Then the paper discusses about the development of new materials and their applications in some typical products, these materials include: nano-materials, ceramic materials, green materials, composite materials and functional materials. Finally, the paper concludes some important factors that may affect the widespread application of new materials.

articleTitle: “Icons of human-symbolizing-god” and “magnifying human nature through god icons”—the aesthetic features of the human icons of Sanxingdui Culture relics
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: What strikes people is the "human icons cluster", which represents the unique geographical cultural characteristics of the Sanxingdui Culture relics. Currently all the researchers believe that the "human icons cluster" is for the ancient religious purpose of sorcery and serves the theme of god-human communication. However, such opinion fails to reveal the connotation at a deeper level. Studied from their contents and forms, the icons cluster indicates the awakening of the ancient Shu people's self-awareness. It is Shu people's attempt to construct artistic world by human standards and to magnify human nature through gods by means of artistic symbols of human icons. Magnifying human nature is the rational kernel lurking in the "human icons cluster", which contributes to the formation of "Beauty of Magnifyingness" in terms of aesthetics.

articleTitle: Online market runners’ liability for IP proprietors: Legal interpretation and legal advancement
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Problems in the two cases concerning Taobao net market expose many conflicts and contradictions in our existing legal documents. In fact, these conflicts and contradictions are the ones in the legal evaluation. Therefore the two cases actually offer us a wonderful opportunity to review the legal interpretation and law advancement. In the legal perspective, discussing the internet market runner's liability for intellectual proprietors goes from the angle of liability and joint defendants as well as from the angle of supervise responsibility. Meanwhile, in the legislative perspective, apart from the process of inform-to-delete, record-to-check process is another choice.

articleTitle: Design development strategy, direction and organization in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Taiwan’s acquisition in the world of its design features and style in a less than three score years, a very short term, is, on one hand, a result of the control and management of design policy, future design direction and state budget resources by the Industry Bureau of Taiwan Economy Department; and is, on the other hand, due to design division of labor between non-governmental and semi-governmental organizations, which leads to entry of Taiwan’s products into the global market. This study is composed of three parts, namely, 1. the present design development directions of Taiwan; 2.analysis of present-day design organizations; 3. investment into design and its execution of Taiwan’s enterprises. The finding is that in the history of Taiwan’s design development, the priority is the emphasis on industry management and innovation, design diagnosis and product development, supported by efforts to increase the competitiveness of the products and to disseminate global design; at the same time, Taiwan is actively involved in constructing design environment for the development of various enterprises, which includes, among other things, the execution of multiple guidance measures, the construction of various design technique support system, the protection of design intellectual property, the provision of subsidiary for enterprises and the repairing of pipes. All these have enabled Taiwan’s glittering in the world.

articleTitle: Contents
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Presents the table of contents of the proceedings.

publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design

articleTitle: [Front cover]
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: applied ergonomics; computer-aided conceptual design; computer-aided design; computer-aided industrial design; product innovation; and design management.

articleTitle: Author index
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Ergonomics research and CNC machine tools in the interface design of the application
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Ergonomics is the early 20th century, the development of a separate subject, is the study of the various conditions under the pleasant, productivity and security, and other properties on the edge of applied sciences, in implementing the theory of ergonomics at the same time, uphold the People-oriented principle of CNC machine tools hardware and software interface design a series of human nature.

articleTitle: Research on the customer requirement information and processing for MC basis on industrial design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the market competition, the diversity and individuality demand of customer integrate into product has become inevitable. The mass customization model takes advantage of an opportunity in homeopathy and come into being. The design and technology to adapt customer-oriented requirement is an important part of the mass customization. In this paper, on the basis of introducing the concept, background of customer-oriented mass customization and the importance of requirement design, the main content and its depicting fuzzy characteristics of consumer’s requirement information are discussed. Using fuzzy theory of knowledge, discusses in detail the actualization method of requirement information: fuzzy definition of requirement information, fuzzy clustering and fuzzy configuring.

articleTitle: The application study of ergonomics on forklift
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Ergonomics, form design and color design are the important constitute of forklift design. Based on the analysis of current status of international and domestic forklift form design, using industrial design theory and methodology and aiming to the three parts, there are respectively some analysis and studies. It also gives some reasonable and concrete design ways. Some ways are also certain references to other type of engineering machines.

articleTitle: Museum recommendation system based on lifestyles
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The existing recommendation system has been widely applied on electronic business field. In recent years, such system has been gradually stepped into the digital teaching field, the advantage of which is to know the preference and interest etc., factors of the learner so as to provide the learner with suitable learning contents. Due to the increasing number of new users and new displaying content, the recommendation system tends to confront with a situation that is incapable and invalid recommendation called ¿cold start¿ problem. In order to solve such problem, we introduce from the viewpoint of sociology to incorporate the lifestyle of the users into the museum recommendation system. This will enable the users inside the museum with a personalized learning service. The character of this system is to take the lifestyle of the users into consideration instead of the system act, further, to analyze the characteristics and to study the favorite displaying content of different clusters through questionnaire survey to take the lifestyle and cluster preference contents as the principle of recommendation items.

articleTitle: A new information leakage defendable model
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In enterprise’s informationization construction, a highly efficient information system inevitably emphasize on the sharing of information, paperless office etc to provide the enterprise information-sharing environment, simultaneously, all data almost can be completely copied in a few minutes, which puts the enterprise information system in high risk, therefore the establishment of an effective and reliable security system has been a top issue to solve the problem of business informationization. But unfortunately, there is not a reasonable solution at present, which can keep the efficiency of the system while protecting the confidentiality of sensitive information. In view of the above-mentioned fact, an intranet information disclosure defendable security model based on both crypt-isolation and log-audit is proposed. This model with both access-audit and encryption method will reasonably control the enterprise staff’s behavior and effectively prevent the enterprise sensitive information from being leaked, intentionally or unintentionally.

articleTitle: Mechanical product growth design based on TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Rapid and automatic growth of organisms is so fascinating that people are trying to make full use of it with every opportunity. Similar relations between organism and product are proposed firstly so that growth design is introduced. Finally, an example of clamp based on TRIZ with the application of soft system is introduced.

articleTitle: An interactive virtual reality system for design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Using virtual reality for interactive design will give the designer an intuitive sense of the performance of the design and allows the designer to achieve a viable, optimal solution in a timely manner. The virtual design system involves three phases mainly. First, the real geographical environment is formed. The building of virtual environment is based on RS, GIS?? and the modeling technique with MultiGen Creator. Next, several approaches to optimize the scene are presented. For the development and navigation in the third period, the platform of VC????6.0 combined with the API of Vega is used. It provides a set of tools for users: to augment graphic elements into the virtual city, visualized query, maintenance of spatial and attribute data, colliding testing, information showing, and LADBM etc. The sample massive virtual scene of LuoGang administration center has high scene complexity, real-time, and interaction. Finally, the paper reports on a study into how models can be turned into digital canvas for urban designers to engage in 3D concept design modeling.

articleTitle: A domestic virtual private network based on remote supervision and operation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The supervision and control of remote domestic electrical equipments and personal computers need a stable virtual private network. This article puts forwards a kind of virtual private network using the Internet and IPv6 technology. Because upgrading port software of former domestic VPN truss is troublesome and difficult, we are aiming at finding a kind of secure, stable, and flexible virtual private network architecture, which is easy to establish, remove, maintain as well as upgrade. Family network based on the application of IPSec and PPP technology transforms the work of gateway and household personal computer; eliminates the redundant overheads of the system; eases the maintenance, and enhances the security.

articleTitle: Design risk management--the guarantee of product innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: English designer Michael Ferry coined the term “design management” in 1966. The term is gradually accepted by company management after more than half a century of development and refinement. However, its importance has yet to be recognized. The ultimate value of industrial design lies in the general public’s understanding and acceptance to the product. The process of accepting a product lies not only in the consumer’s fulfillment of their materialistic demands, but more so in the fulfillment of their spiritual needs. Therefore, product innovation is essential. At the same time, such innovation brings the element of risk to the process. This article analyses the avoidance and legal issues of design risks in order to emphasize the importance of design management and its implementation. It also discusses the economics of risk management analysis and risk management tools in order to demonstrate its effectiveness in mitigating possible risks and achieving the ultimate objective of design management: making designs better at serving enterprises, and creating greater worth.

articleTitle: A research for relations between colors and driving fatigue
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Driving is a complex man-machine process, color signal is an important factor for affecting driving fatigue. In the course of driving simulation, using different color signals to stimulate the drivers, through subjective questionnaires and measuring the changes in drivers’ physiological parameters, to research the changing law of the drivers’ heart rate, respiratory rate and other physiological signals and analys of different colors and composition of factors and Driver fatigue, identify the impact of color signal to fatigue on driving, explore ways to slow fatigue driving.

articleTitle: An investigation on Operator interface of Utility Vehicle based on Multi-discipline fusion design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Combined with the actual design of the operator interface of Utility Vehicle, this paper analyzes Interface Design in Industrial Design from various aspects. Based on the full survey and research work of the design background and the market, the essay analyses the theories of all kinds, such as shape, function, ergonomic, as well as color in the using and operation of the operator interface design with the help of interface design theory. Directed towards the specific design of operator interface of Utility Vehicle, this paper puts forward the integrated design of different subjects, which include ergonomics, color science, functional theory, psychology, and etc, making a breakthrough concerned about the traditional theory that attributing human factors to the ergonomics. Therefore, we can not only make Interface Design reflect Human-Machine performance and meet the practical requirements of HMI operation, and also expand the design factors to the psychological, spiritual areas.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of the Cooperative Design System of Ceramic Patterns
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: All over the world, China is one of the main countries in ceramic manufacturing, while it is factually weak in ceramic export. How to promote the quality of ceramic products? It is a main mode to reform the instrument of ceramic decorative pattern to promote the quality of ceramics and enhance its competitiveness. This paper mainly discusses the module of Ceramic Pattern’s Cooperative Design System Based on Internet, proceeds to analyze and induce the technology of the protocols of communication, which corresponds with the Ceramic Pattern’s Cooperative Design system. Meanwhile, it puts forward the concept of designer-customer cooperation in the procedure of designing ceramic patterns. It mainly studies the design procedure under designer-customer cooperative design system and the realization of the core algorithm of designer-customer cooperative design system, and its implementation and use in Interactive Ceramic Pattern Design System Based on Internet.

articleTitle: Research on human-computer-interaction design of software based on barrier-free principle
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper discusses the human-computer interaction design of the software based on barrier-free principle. By analyzing the behavior characteristics and the actual requirements, when operating software, of disadvantaged groups, such as the color-blind, the left-handed and the elderly, the project investigates the physiological peculiarities of vulnerable groups and emphasizes the principle of ¿people foremost¿ in the whole process of human-computer-interaction design. Moreover, the design philosophy, solutions and primary idiographic operating methods in creating different operation interfaces are also brought forward to meet the needs of these special groups.

articleTitle: The research on the innovation of digital concept design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Thanks to the constant development of computer science, new CAD technology has been emerging in endless these years. In the process of modern design, it is quite indispensable for an excellent designer that learns the technology and creates better design with it. Besides, illogical thinking is an essential kind of thinking mode that sometime helps designers solve problems. This paper explains the necessity of using CAD technology and illogical thinking, and shows how they work together to achieve a better design. The destination of using CAD technology is to exhibit designers¿ concept completely, and therefore designers should keep their mind innovative when using CAD technology to develop their concept design. In this way, they can make much better design than ever.

articleTitle: Research on the Service-oriented Customizable Cooperative Cork Framework
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the Web, service customization is a new software development modality on the industrialized software integration development platform. The design and development of the customizable cooperative work framework¿s architecture and software development tool¿s running platform have been described in this thesis. The business object component¿s attribute and presentation modality, service customization component and the business workflow instance can be customized through cooperative working of the frameworks to implement customizing the service process, which improves the effective of the manipulation among the business workflows and supports the flexible customization for the presentation user interface. As a new cooperative software development pattern, the customizable cooperative work framework can be used to customize a specific service process. The customizable cooperative work framework can support the customization and implementation of development and running the software archetype system in the special domain without recoding, re-compiling and re-deploying components.

articleTitle: Establishment of soybean shape model based on the feedback mechanisms of structure—Function
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to truly reflect the growth mechanism of soybean, based on the principle of Green-Lab model and combined with field data of 2007, this paper raised one method for establish soybean virtual model, which have the feedback mechanism of structure and function. it generate soybean topology use dual-scale automaton. The method of establishing model resolved the defect which simulated simply from the soybean plant structure. Realizing the structure run parallel with function of the soybean plants simulation, faithful to the growth of plants, and laid the foundation for proposing super high-yielding ideal type of soybean plant.

articleTitle: Design of a cross-domain privilege management prototype system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to implement resource sharing and security cooperation among domains in distributed environment, cross-domain authorization and access control become core issues. The existing privilege management product implement cross-domain authorization by directly issuing attribute certificate to foreign entities, which can¿t satisfy the security requirement of dynamic and open distributed environment. The IRBAC 2000 model accomplish interoperation flexibly by dynamic inter-domain role mapping, based on this model, a new cross-domain privilege management prototype system (CD-PMPS) is proposed, and its working process is given, so that the cross-domain authorization issue can be easily resolved.

articleTitle: On critical regionalism saving our architecture design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In confrontation with the temptation of assimilation of global culture, our architects either directly play a disarming role or find supports from regionalism. It is easy for us to distinguish these two extremes individual features of Chinese architecture are stepping into, which involve our blind obedience to internationalism and overindulgence in the serious degeneration of traditional value in the depth of our mind in the first regard, and the second one reflecting the reliance on irrational mechanical regionalism resists the attack caused by the assimilation of global culture to make substantial fake antiques in terms of pretension that our traditional culture are booming always. However, neither of those two extremes can shape the change that our designs for architecture are undergoing the depression of national characteristics. Critical regionalism has provided news solutions to problems for us.

articleTitle: Research of flexographic printing dot measurement instrument based on adaptive background method
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The accurate measurement of the dot area during the process of flexographic plate making and printing is of great significance to the enhancement of flexographic printing quality. The flexographic printing dot measurement instrument PDMIABM is presented. PDMIABM uses the proposed dot measurement algorithm ABMMPD based on adaptive background method to measure the dot geometric parameters such as percentage dot area. ABMMPD can automatically eliminate the influence which is caused by illumination and so on. The experimental results show that ABMMPD can measure the dot geometric parameters more accurately than previous methods.

articleTitle: Spending a festival of traditional design ----On present design of chinese festival print in China
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The importance of traditional arts lies on its profound social meaning and some certain psychological accumulation, and it has been kept pursuiting beauty in the course of history. Chinese traditional art is broad and profound. Now the introduction of new idea and thinking pattern provides us a broader view to re-examine traditional art, and the new technology and material also give more possibilities for us in the redesign of traditional festival print. This paper analyzes the design style and essentials of traditional festival print, and discuss the elements that should be noticed, and raise new viewpoints to the present design of festival print.

articleTitle: Playful factors in interactive design of automotive GPS
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: There exists the interactivity which is natural and innovative because of relationship between individual and automotive GPS. In this process we can be psychologically satisfied. Using images and sounds to grasp information is to the point of principle of receiving happiness. Playfulness is one of human’s natural features, which brings great influences to design of automotive GPS that playful factor can not be ignored. I put forward a Strategy in this article to achieve the playful interactive design of automotive GPS, which is “visual beauty and appeal”. The “visual beauty” refers to the visual enjoyment. “Appeal” refers to both of static product modeling and dynamic operation. This article goes from the visual aestheticism law and appealing modeling to mode of operation to expanse the whole Strategy.

articleTitle: The characteristics of modern design in the scope of consumer culture
