publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the development of economic and in-depth process of globalization and modernization, China is meeting the social change from the center of traditional “manufacturing products” to the center of “consumption” and consumer services. As one main social activity of modern society, consumption is playing an important and significant role in Chinese socio-economic and cultural life increasingly. In the spread of consumerism, design is mainly reflecting the aesthetic forms of consumer culture. It plays a very important role of training the public as consumers, creating the demand for consumption and the consumer environment. But once humans pay more homage to material, we will loss ourselves in the process of enjoying material. This paper analyses the unique features of design in the scope of consumer culture as follows. Design is a means to make goods symbolic, and it should service for commodities’ image as a kind of applied commodity aesthetics. Through the analysis of characteristics we can lead the development of modern design direction and guide the design to play a positive function in consumer culture.

articleTitle: Comparison and implication: Patent strategies of China, Japan and U.S.A
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper analyzed China¿s current legislation on intellectual property rights and the construction countermeasure, summed up the characteristics of patent strategy in the enterprises of Japan and the United States, base on this and propose that we take patent strategy as the foundation, to protect designing innovative of Chinese enterprises: Such as learn from Japanese experience, we may hold the advanced techniques through introduction of foreign technology, exploiting many small patents, build a external network of patents, foster our strengths and circumvent our weaknesses, value the role of patent intelligence. We should strengthen the exploitation and utilization of spare patents. Rather as America has done, we may connect our patents and intellectual property with foreign trade in order to control other countries¿ markets and keep our superiority in technological monopoly by adapting a series of policies and regulations.

articleTitle: Theoretics of environmentally conscious industry design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: At the present time the collapsing environment is the most crucial problem for human to deal with, we destroy environment continuously to fill the increasing need of our living, industry design bear responsibility for this. To save our environment, we put forward ¿sustainable development¿ as the development principle all over the world. Environmentally conscious industry design is brought forward in this instance. Environmentally conscious industry design is obligatory technical foundation of sustainable development, at the same time sustainable development exploits new occasion for industry design. The paper will present four means: fundamental of environmentally conscious industry design, service design, consumption design, and the way of environmentally conscious product appearance evaluate.

articleTitle: Study on volume minimizing design principle in CSCD
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Minimum volume design is traditionally used as an optimization method which is based on objectives, design variables and constraint conditions, rather than a guiding principle that can promote the creative design. According to the tendency of modern design and the former optimization design of minimum volume, this paper proposes a new volume minimizing design principle(VMDP) in computer supported collaborative design (CSCD). The aim of VMDP is to excavate human being’s design wisdom and creative ability of manufacture and design maximally, to excavate the material’s properties and potential abilities maximally. The essence of VMDP is to realize that the product’s units and subunits occupy the minimal volume while their functions and capacities are maximum in unit volume, the products will be manufactured with the least material resources while they have the benefits of green design and manufacture. According to binary inference feedback algorithm, the optimization theory and mathematical model of the volume minimizing design principle in guiding the design process are developed.

articleTitle: Modern enterprise modeling in STEP
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The existing product data formats are not unified, the enterprise product data and the management information can¿t directly be shared among the various interior departments of the enterprise and among the enterprises. This article firstly gave the framework of dynamic unified enterprise model, which is a three-dimensional enterprise model described in the multi-views and given the first place to the product view. Its modeling process is a circulation loop including product call back and disposal. And then, the methods of using the STEP (Standards for the Exchange of Product model data) to describe enterprise model information were expatiated on, giving an instance by these methods. Adopting above modeling methods, the enterprise model information are both easily read and used by model using personnel and can be directly transferred through computer. The effective information integration can be realized.

articleTitle: Toy, breathing a new life into traditional arts
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Chinese traditional art is Chinese Nation¿s treasure, but it is faded out gradually and forgotten by us. Toy is looked as the carrier and platform of action and thought communication, People will understand culture, learn history and enjoy art through the enjoyment of toy when toy carries all the elements of traditional art. With the increasing popularity of modern toy design, traditional art will play an important role in people¿s life. When traditional art is used in modern toy design, we need take interest, aesthetics and modern crafts into consideration, distinguish it from pure traditional art, make it suit the society and the development of the aesthetics. Finally, it is provided with the potential of persistent life.

articleTitle: On sponsors and land art
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Land art first began in the 1960s coinciding with the global environmental protection movement. Artists created many large-scale artistic landscapes in natural settings and initiated intense argument about the relationship between nature and human culture. The general understanding of land art is: it is the betrayer of tradition ¿studio - museum¿ system with the goal to rebel against and flee from commercialized control. They have every reason to refuse sponsorship which is part of ¿the capitalism artistic mechanism¿. However, reality is the opposite. This article studies the role of sponsors for the land art. On one hand, land art betrays the traditional ¿studio - museum¿ system; on the other hand, patronage reflects a social relationship in art. The paper aims to probe into this seemingly contradictory sponsor problem in land art.

articleTitle: Research of usability test mode based on the implicit user behavior lib
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Usability has been used to measure the core Competitive ability of domestic products. Since usability testing cannot be limited to the tradition manual testing method, a new usability research model of implicit collection of user behavior lib has invoked the interest of the big name corporations. Based on the slideshow dual screen notebook’s auxiliary screen focus functionality development, usability principles and UCD method, extracting 31 usability collecting data points of implicit user behaviors, then transform the data into measurement of data collection, this article gives out data display algorithm of user behavior lib. It sets up the procedure of implicit mining user behavior lib. This method applies to the creation of implicit collection of user behavior lib used by usability testing.

articleTitle: The focal point of college education is to train talent with pragmatic qualities
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The problems of college education at the present stage. Taking decoration design market for example, analyse the phenomena now among college students that “graduation equals unemployment”, and find the reason. First, strategic planning should be established in practice teaching. Second, carry out the marketdriven reformation in college practice teaching, and what’s more, build up more subdivided decoration design laboratories.

articleTitle: The research on semiotics applications in the internet time
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper using the principles of ergonomics and analyzing network symbol system with basic theory of symbol reveals the ¿virtual world¿ network¿s symbols characteristics and the new characteristics of people¿s information needs and acceptance, and describes the development trend of symbols in Network Interactive System, and then discovers new changes and new requirements of the interactive design in network ¿virtual world¿.

articleTitle: Interactive walkthrough of the virtual campus based on VRML
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: An interactive walkthrough system is designed based on Virtual Reality. The techniques of Virtual Reality Model Language(VRML) and Java are combined in this system, and the virtual scenes and Human-Computer Interaction have been realized. In order to increase the speed of browsing the scenes, some optimal methods have been used in dealing with the model files.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of a kind of redundant actuation shaking table
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper brought forward a novel shaking table actuated by servo motors. It adopted the redundant actuation parallel mechanism as the main structure. The kinematic characteristics were analyzed by aid of parallel mechanism type synthesis principles, which showed that it had six degree of freedoms. In order to verify the output motion characteristics, kinematic model of this redundant actuation shaking table was constructed and simulated. Some key problems including the manufacture of sphere joint, control system design and programming were also presented.

articleTitle: Reseach on technology development actuality of the virtual reality applied to design& manufacturing processes
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The opinion that technology can dispiace a person to a different environment without any physical movement and create the illusion of interaction with the artificial environment is not new. Engineers and scientists have been dedicating their efforts to its progressive development over the last sixty years. However, most of the technological advances have been made in the last twenty years, At present, virtual reality is completely applied in different fields, such as robotics telemedicine, or cinematography. Following on from this success, the question arises of whether we have plan to apply it to industrial design and manufacturing processes. Rapid evolution of this technology applied to CAD/CAM over the last twenty years, together with the lack of recent reviews on it, have been the basic motivations to develop this study.

articleTitle: Research on business process management system based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In allusion to accelerate the running speed and improve competitiveness of enterprise, this paper constructs a business process management system architecture based on service oriented architecture (SOA). The workflow engine, business process engine and rule engine are designed, and the operational mechanisms of these engines are researched. In order to achieve automation and intelligence in the process of business process, the mechanism of abnormality processing based on process abnormity set is designed. Finally, the validity of the system was proved by an example.

articleTitle: Study of information axiom in evaluation method of product design scheme
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The keys of product development are how to distinguish the optimal designs from the bad designs at the early design stage and how to reduce the iterative error rate. Hence the evaluation method for product design schemes is important for decision making in the design process. Using the information axiom of axiomatic design, this paper combines analytic hierarchy process with fuzzy evaluation. Taking Haier U-home products as an example, this paper makes up the evaluation index of products by product’s four elements, and also concludes the index information calculation formula based on information axiom. It comprehensive considerate the weight of various indexes and supply gives the calculation formulae of information content of evaluation indexes and the evaluation and decision making method for design schemes. So that it can provide a scientific decision basis and get a good foundation for the automation process of product design.

articleTitle: Judgment and rhetoric: Further thought aroused by two Taobao cases
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Parties of the cases concerning online market runners put forward their pleading and defense on the judgment. The judges rendered their judgments - sustain, and offered their argumentation. All these defense and argumentation go with the process of rhetoric. Exactly speaking, convincing others is the ultimate purpose, expressing their own claimed wordings. Herein the two Taobao cases give us a chance to review judgment and rhetoric.

articleTitle: The implementation of CAN—Ethernet communication system on the missile simulation and detection platform
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the advantages of high speed, high efficiency and low error rate, CAN-Ethernet is used to achieve the interconnecting communication in the research of a certain kind of missile simulation and detection platform. The CAN-Ethernet bridge is designed by utilizing the development board with the LPC2210 microcontroller as the core to achieve the mutual transformation between CAN data frame and Ethernet date frame, making possible the mutual circulation of the two heterogeneous networks. Furthermore, UDP data transceiver is used at the end of ethernet, to improve the transmitting efficiency of data. When the compiled software program is runned on this platform at last, it proves a good result, thus realizing the downlink of command and uplink of data. This paper discusses the design method of bridge, the design of various ports among hardware parts as well as the implementation of CAN bus communication.

articleTitle: Digital construction—construction research in virtual space
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Digital construction which based on the traditional construction utilizes the computers¿ advantage in virtual space construction to lead the expansion of imagination space and three-dimensional shaping to express construction creativity. The article compared the traditional construction with digital construction, introduced six basic methods of computer virtual shaping and how to use three-dimensional virtual shaping software to process shaping creation. The article points out the widespread applications of digital construction in real life, with updates of three-dimensional computer technology, digital construction will have more broad development prospects.

articleTitle: Kitchenware design improvement based on contrast of dietetic Cultures between China and western countries
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Kitchenware design is becoming and will always be the focus of the modern society since it is one of the typical aspects that represent life level. Along with developing technology, Chinese cuisine is changing. This paper intends to discuss the design trends of kitchenware in modern Chinese families based on contrast of dietetic Cultures between China and western countries as well as on people’s lifestyles and needs. It can be divided into four parts: the background and importance of the kitchenware industry towards the Chinese market, the major dissimilarities in dietetic culture between China and western countries, features of Chinese dietetic culture and western dietetic culture, the possible kitchenware design direction.

articleTitle: The research of Computer Aided Ergonomics analysis in farm machinery
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The ergonomics question in farm machinery relates operators¿ safety and efficiency, which is important aspect in the farm machinery design. But the developed Computer Aided Ergonomics software has not human body database, which is needed in view of farm machinery design in China, therefore the farm machinery design have deviation in Ergonomics analysis. This article propose that using the open database interface procedure in CATIA to establish human body database which designs in view of the farm machinery design, and reading the human body data to Ergonomics module of CATIA can Product practical application hypothesized person, using Human Posture Analysis and Human Activity Analysis module analysis the Ergonomics in farm machinery, thus a new analysis farm machinery ergonomics method can be realized.

articleTitle: A study of kitchen service system design based on design investigation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper puts forward a new procedure that brings ¿design investigation¿ into the course of new product design. The kitchen service system design is used as an example, which verified that the procedure is feasible. The procedure will improve the innovation level of the new product, and make the new product easier to be success.

articleTitle: Divergent thinking based on the symbol design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Industrial design researches “people” and creates “objects”, which, therefore, can not be separated from the creation of form. Human beings are developing with the discovery and creating the shape, who also has “cultured” our own sensory organ in the cognition and shape, endowing form with expression, forming the symbol, thence symbol is looked as the visual carrier of emotion, served as a bridge of spirited communication. The history of mankind is also the history of creating and using symbols. The mankind’s process of consciousness is actually the process of symbolizing the world. The arrival of digital age makes design be in the age of rebuilding semiotic system. So the design of symbols becomes the very important issue that every designer must be faced. Thinking is the process of selecting, assembling, converting and regenerating of symbols. This paper is targeted in the design of symbols, pulling into divergent thinking, thinking in all directions, exploring a variety way of problem-solving, starting with the use of emotion and patterns, instructions and patterns, symbolic and patterns, national character and patterns, and exploring symbol design’s methods and ways during the information age.

articleTitle: Application of HPJava in parallel computing
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The article discusses the application of HPJava language for parallel computing and various rules about use of distributed arrays in HPJava programes. We illustrated how to build a Beowulf system under Linux and HPJava and use matrix multiplication parallel algorithm module design to test this Beowulf system.

articleTitle: Application of Data Warehouse techniques in enterprise Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The Decision Support System(DSS) as one kind smart software system of the important application value, provides each kind of decision information as well as the commercial question solution for the enterprise. Thus it reduced the superintendent to be engaged in the low level information processing and the analysis burden, and the DSS caused them to dedicate most needs the decisions wisdom and the experience work, therefore improved the decisions quality and the efficiency. The system is born of the DSS of a metal limited company. The paper studies on the development of a DSS based on the structure of Client/server, including the interfaces between the software of DSS and the practical and special matters of the company. During the development of the software, the principles of software engineering are followed by the system, and the module method is used. The technique of Data Warehouse(DW) is also used in the development of DSS. Through the tracing, maintenance, it shows that the system has been developed reasonably and has run effectively. Under the web environment the system runs stably, and has the good practicability, friendly interface and good safety. It is also capable of improving the scientific policy ability of companies.

articleTitle: An individual customization system for shoe products based on the network
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Individual customization on the Internet is a new production and sale mode appearing in recent years which uses information technology and network technology to customize production. Individual customization system is designed and realized for shoe products based on B/S structure. This system not only provides professional guidance and advices for shoe choosing but also realizes shoe customization online. Through this customization platform, the individual shoe products are manufactured which satisfied customers¿ requirement of appearance and wearing comfort.

articleTitle: From architectural design to product design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The Product Design is a subject in the field of application; the way of development of the theoretic is constantly learn from the success of other subjects to enrich their own theoretical system. Due to Product Design and Architecture Design are essentially the same, even as architecture has undergone thousands of years of evolution, the theory and the system info had been fully developed. It is worth learning and provides reference for product design. Based on comparison and analysis of seven basic elements of Architecture: functionality, artistry, architectural, history, philosophy, social, cultural and science technology, this article discusses necessary and essential conditions that product design should have and show the direction of the theory of product design in the future.

articleTitle: An elementary analysis on modern novel seats design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the concept of novel seats design, the authors analyses the current development of the novel seats design and figure out its merits and demerits of novel seats, finally the authors give the development trend of novel seats design in future.

articleTitle: Analysis and application of virtual reality technology in protection of cultural heritage
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The article focuses on the application of virtual reality technology in the protection of cultural heritage. The technology utilizes multiple means, such as three-dimensional display technology, video, audio, animation, pictures and text, to provide an innovative solution for the conflict between cultural heritage protection and tourism development with the Heritage three-dimensional model as the index.

articleTitle: Simulation and experiment research on human riding comfort for vehicle vibration in dynamic environment
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: According to the needs of simulation research of human riding comfort for vehicle vibration in dynamic environment, the mathematical model of random road is established using white noise. The model has been subsequently introduced into Matlab/Simulink to simulate several different incentive forms of random road, and the time-domain model of random road excitation-according with Chinese Highway Standard is developed. Moreover, vehicle dynamics model is set up in dynamics analysis software ADAMS, and human biological structure model-coincident with Chinese body characteristics is done alike in ADAMS/LifeMOD. These two models are assembled to construct a biomechanical simulation model of human-vehicle system. Aimed to get vertical vibration response of vehicle and human at different speeds and different road levels, the biomechanical simulation model of human-vehicle system is imitatively analyzed by introduction of random road excitation model. Furthermore, an evaluation study on human riding comfort for vehicle vibration in dynamic environment is presented on the basis of national standard GB/T4970. The objective evaluation test on human vibration comfort is carried out on random vibration platform SA30-S802/ST, the experimental results showed that the results of the objective evaluation test basically tally with the simulation results. The research above provides an important method for the design and analysis of vehicle man-machine interface in dynamic environment and has important technical significance for rapid evaluation of human driving comfort.

articleTitle: The effect of internet-lifestyle on personal blog template preference
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Blog has become the commonest network product. There were usually over one hundred templates for one blog product. The main aim of this paper is to find what make user select one blog template instead of the others. To this end, 11 variables were defined to describe every blog template. Findings from a sample of 30 active NetEase blog users suggest that internet-lifestyle is influential to blog template preference. This study may provide blog template designers with some guiding principles when making user-centered interface design.

articleTitle: Application of Chinese Shang bronze culture in wine package design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a new method for wine package design by applying Chinese bronze culture symbol to exhibit the national cultural and aesthetic meanings of wine and to fit the customer’s culture demands. Based on analyzing the characteristics of Shang bronze shapes, decorative patterns and aesthetic ideas, combining with the cultural characteristics of wine package, the work presented in this paper obtained a series of design methods of wine package by applying Chinese Shang bronze culture. These methods mainly include orienting of aesthetic ideas, selecting of bronze symbols and creating of container shapes and decorative patters. Then a typical wine package case was designed and analyzed by applying these design methods. These package design methods not only can bring national culture values for wine, new consuming concepts and aesthetic ideas for people, but also can promote the competitive ability for enterprise.

articleTitle: Thinking of modern design from the angle of cultural ecology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Human being can change the environment, while the environment can change human being as well. As human’s important creative activity, design runs through human’s produce and life all along. Thinking of modern design from the angle of cultural ecology aims at attracting more attention from all over the world to the problem of China’s modern design cultural ecology so as to give modern design more profound meaning under the condition of world wide assimilation.

articleTitle: Three dimensional parameterized design of heat exchanger tubesheet based on SolidWorks
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Three dimensional solid-modeling revolution has reached the design mainstream. In this paper, the parameterized design method of tubesheet and principle of automatic tube layout for shell-and-tube heat exchanger were investigated. Parameterized modeling and automatic engineering drawing creating for heat exchanger tubesheet were realized by the development of SolidWorks based on VB (Visual Basic), Microsoft Access and API (application programming interface) provided by SolidWorks. The software system has achieved prearranged development goals, namely simplifying designing procedure, greatly saving the time that designer used to draw a chart and significantly reducing probability of mistakes. When modifying design parameters, it has direct-viewing, accurate and highly effective merits, which is good for companies to reduce the design period and to gain broad market acceptance. At the same time, this software has good adaptability, human-computer interaction and expansibility and it will be benefit to the development of the three dimensional modeling of heat exchanger. Moreover, the research method of tubesheet auto-drawing is suitable for other equipment design software developments.

articleTitle: The digitized technology and the design thought expression searches discusses
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In the traditional art and digital art and the line today, digital technology-aided design to the design and concept art has brought great changes, a design, innovative new trend. This paper aims to digital technology and design thinking of ways to explore a shallow, so as to make better use of new technology-assisted art and design.

articleTitle: The World Expo’s history and principle evolve
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The World Expo is a large-scale, global, non-commercial Expo. The hosting of the World Expo must be applied for by a country and approved by the international World Expo committee. Expo aims to promote the exchange of ideas and development of the world economy, culture, science and technology, to allow exhibitors to publicise and display their achievements and improve international relationships. Accordingly, the World Expo with its 150-year history is regarded as the Olympic Games of the economy, science and technology. World Expositions are galleries of human inspirations and thoughts. Since 1851 when the Great Exhibition of Industries of All Nations was held in London, the World Expositions have attained increasing prominence as grand events for economic, scientific, technological and cultural exchanges, serving as an important platform for displaying historical experience, exchanging innovative ideas, demonstrating esprit de corps and looking to the future.

articleTitle: Substance-field analysis and effects for conceptual design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A computer aided innovation system, called Pro/Smart, based on substance-field analysis and effects etc has been developed. The system has three major functions, i.e. substance-field analysis, contradiction matrix for problem solving and the effects knowledge database for conceptualization. The substance-field module is to analyze the interactions between components of a product and to find the potential improving methods. The innovation module is to find the technical conflicts in the existing product, and the solutions are provided with typical and analytical examples. The effects module provided a knowledge database for enlightening of novel design ideas. Though it is an on-going project, two design examples are utilized in the developed modules to verify the effectiveness of TRIZ theory, the proposed methodology and the developed software system.

articleTitle: Research on fast super-resolution image reconstruction base on image sequence
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The image degradation caused by Motion blur, non-ideal sample and noise was producing in the process of Image Acquirement. This paper proposed a fast super-resolution image reconstruction algorithm basing on image sequences. On the basis of image registration, Registration algorithm used Affine Transform as geometric transform Model. A sequence of low-resolution images was roughly registered basing on feature and then use Registration algorithm basing on Gray to optimize the result. Iterative back-projection technique was used to construct high resolution from image sequences. Firstly it made common low-resolution sequence images relate to standard displacements, and then reconstructed high-resolution image according to the relationship between low-resolution sequence images with standard displacement and high-resolution image. The high-frequency was distilled through the local estimation. By compensating the high-frequency component, the high-resolution images were recovered. Experimental results show that this algorithm solve the problem that the translation and rotation is small in traditional method. It has characterized over low computation complexity, fast convergence. The details, definition and resolution of high resolution image processed with the proposed method are effectively improved.

articleTitle: Body and office chairs---the science of sitting
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Man’s body is not straight, which is determined by biomorph. Therefore, a “competent” office chair must be consistent with the shape of human body, and their characteristics of movement, etc. From the perspective of ergonomics, this thesis aims to talk about some characteristics that an excellent office chair should have.

articleTitle: Neck characteristic parameters mathematical model
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This study aims to develop some neck characteristic parameters and to build virtual neck model of individual that can be used in the collar design of virtual fashion design. Through principal component factor analysis for the 3D neck anthropometric measurements of 200 female graduate students aged between 22 and 27, the paper presents some neck characteristic parameters, such as neck girth, neck width and back neck angle et al, and proposes a method to build an individual virtual neck model for Chinese young women that can be used to design MTM(made to measure) collar in virtual fashion design.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of industrial design education between China and western countries
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The rapid development of industrial design education in our country brings us a lot of problems. We should realize that many potential unstable factors are hidden in the development. In order to solve these problems and to provide useful experience for our industrial design education as a reference, this article is concerned with observation of the industrial design education overseas. And it makes a comparison of the differences between Chinese and foreign countries, such as the education system, cultivation goals, curriculum system, faculty structure, and other areas. The existed problems of industrial design education in china are pointed out and are explained in details by the comparison with western countries. At the end, some recommendations are given by author.

articleTitle: An automobile seat comfort evaluation method based on fuzzy support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The objective of this study was the application of driving comfort for the prediction of the driver’ seat. At the first, triangular type membership function was introduced to depict the driver’s feeling of comfort for the uncertain meaning of “comfort”, and then a model was built to assess the relation between design parameters and comfort assessment based on Fuzzy SVM. This method can also be used to solve other relative problems.

articleTitle: The Scenario-oriented Design in design education
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Scenario-oriented Design is a kind of user-centered design method,it can contain various kind of questions, combine relevant view among ample resources, and it’s an application of the vision dialog, an effective tool to formulate uncertainty. This paper introduce Scenario-oriented Design of method at first, then discuss it’s advantage and disadvantage. Finally, we do an all-round way discuss of the use actor, the use environment and the use scene for MP3 song-seller with the matchmakers of the method, propose the sense and some personal opinion about the method in design education. We hope to inspire the learner to explore the design requirements more close to user mind from user stand.

articleTitle: Virtual design and simulation in new produt development of automobile sunroof
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper the reverse engineering and Software Catia were applied to create the 3D digital model. Then the model was imported into ADAMS to build the virtual prototype. After that the key components which affect the movement characteristics of the sunroof were abstracted out to build the kinematic model. Then the virtual assembling, kinematics simulation and analysis were done with ADAMS software. Finally, a parameter optimization was done based on the study result of the simulation and analysis. The study in this paper can not only improve the design quality and development efficiency of new automotive sunroof productions, but also remarkably shorten the Production development period and reduce the development cost.

articleTitle: The analysis to the Chu—art in the international cultural vision
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Art North-South diversion, which is a can not be evaded and ignored geographical phenomenon in Chinese art history. Back in the prehistoric art of embryonic period, the artistic phenomenon produced in home soil of the Yellow River Basin of the north and the Yangtze River Basin of the south, existent obviously the North-South differences in style and temperament. Art is the combiner of emotional elements and combine elements, is a visual table of Italian culture, it is the most full of originality, is a change in the most free areas. At the same time it is the visual arts, has strong adsorptive, variability, integration, when it materialized in the form of time.This text contrasts such cultural differences, and discusses its own characteristics and deep influence and role in the art of modern art gallery.

articleTitle: The development of Environmental Art in the inheritance and innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Environmental Art is closely related to our human life, production, work and leisure. It also can make a delicate impact to our feelings. As the improving of the standard of people’s life, the appreciation of various types environmental of art has not only remain in its existing form, but also the cultural tastes and technology content which they reflect. Environmental Art wants to be truly understood by the contemporary people, we must follow certain rules, but the rules are not detained, not the only rules which can limit your imagination, it must meet the aesthetic standards of contemporary people. The existence of Environmental art must be able to play the role which can improve people’s level of appreciation. The development of Environmental Art needs innovation, it is not to say that we should overthrow the tradition completely, but use of various reasonable means to express our own ideas through the expression of the traditional, we should spark the road of Environment-art design with the help of the collision of inheritance and innovation.

articleTitle: Study on the sculpture method modeling of folk handicraft
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Folk handicraft is an important part of non-material cultural heritage meanwhile the research on modeling method technology is the premise and important content of digital protection of non-material cultural heritage. The paper brought up a sculpture modeling method concept through the analysis of folk handicraft, discussed the thought and process of the method, and described its key technology. Finally, the feasibility of sculpture method modeling was verified through the modeling experiment of Fengxiang clay sculpture.

articleTitle: Disciplinary lessons of Ulm model
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Hochschule fur Gestaltung Ulm, which was built in the mid 20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> century, is like ¿A big laboratory¿ in the open, active and conflicting field of design. As design is increasingly becoming the focus and the frontier discipline in the industrial society, the innate crack between art and design inside the institute emerged, until the word ¿Art¿ became an implicit taboo of the institute. These conflicts, however, are the previous discussion and clarification of certain basic ambiguity for Chinese design education, where both the opportunity and problem co-exist. Because of the value of the Ulm model, it indeed is the mirrors that is able to solve the dilemma in Chinese design discipline whether it is related to ¿Advantages or disadvantages, gains or loss¿.

articleTitle: On digital processing applied in two-dimensional constitution teaching
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Computer Aided Design has been applied in teaching about ten years, but most Computer Aided Design was focused on software operation or aided in special design. Two-dimensional constitution, the basic design course which is a subject related to graphic design and creative thinking ability training. Paper through discussion about the influence of teaching and leaning about digital processing applied in constitution course, to demonstrate digital processing applied in modern constitution is an indispensable method and will benefit teachers as well as students.

articleTitle: Unscrambling and developing distillation of Ouyao kiln clture
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Ouyao kiln (a chinaware kiln in ancient Ou) is a famous celadon kiln born, developed and declined in historical cultural city Wenzhou (called Yongjia County in ancient China). It was set up in Donghan Dynasty, flourishing in Tang Dynasty after the development in Dongjin Dynasty, Xijin Dynasty and Nanbei Dynasty and declined in Yuan and Song Dynasty for some reasons. So it has a long history and abundant culture connotation. The stipples of Brown glaze decoration on celadon indicate the wisdom, simple goodness and love of life of laboring people for its rusticity and condense. Furthermore, a harbor bureau was set up in Wenzhou in South Song dynasty to administer the newly-opened treaty port. Wenzhou once became a very important port on the “China Road” for its significant contribution on the cross-culture communication, especially the pottery and porcelain culture communication.

articleTitle: Design of residential area roaming system and information management based on virtual reality
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Virtual reality technology has become the hotspot in the information field in recent years. The roaming system design of residential area is of great importance to the community management and urban planning. In this paper, a typical residential area is taken as a prototype. 3DSMAX and VRML are adopted to construct the virtual scene. Combining VRML with JavaScript, the interactive function between the virtual scene and the entities is realized. At the same time, connection of VRML and database helps to facilitate the service company to enquiry and manage residents¿ living environment, and also provide the information for the potential customer who wants to purchase the apartment.

articleTitle: Emulation and simulation of dynamic weighting signal
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper discusses the researching process of simulating dynamic weighting signal in the aspect of signal on MATLAB, based on the conception and researching method of virtual instrument. The signal simulation includes parts of the production line, the mechanism of balance (a Second-Order Underdamped System), response of object, response of the mechanism and power frequency noise. This paper analyzes the structure of dynamic weighting device and mathematical model of the signal simulation structure in the background of dynamic monitoring of dynamic weighting on packing production line. Virtual instrument function is designed on MATLAB, the simulating signal is generated by MCU, D/A converters and RS232 serial interfaces. Users can get signal from the output channel of virtual instrument signal source according to the signal¿s feature, and send the signal to electronic measuring unit, and perform debugging and studying. Comparation is made between the simulate signal and the filed signal.

articleTitle: Research and application for modeling method of product design based on three-dimensional scanning cechnology
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The efficiency and quality of product design (PD) is essentially about designer as well as in a rapidly changing and keenly competitive environment. The work presented in this paper focuses on presenting a new kind of modeling method of product design, which introduced three-dimensional scanning technology into the course of PD. The method used in our study is known as direction by model. When we had an original draft, we manufactured products model first in the phase of concept design using some common materials such as wood, ABS, gypsum, greasy soil and so on. Than we measured the model with the three-dimensional scanner obtaining the point clouds of the model. Finally, we could construct the substantiated model through the point clouds. In comparison to the traditional computer aided design process, this method can firstly develop the originality of designer in a more extensive range. Secondly, we can acquire the feedback of feeling sense and touching sense of the product in an earlier phase, so we can save times and cost for bridge over the repeatedly modifying in the stage of prototype. In order to prove our view we carried out several studies which have demonstrated that this method can improve the efficiency of design process by 43% and decrease the times of amending in later period of the design by about 450%. And it cuts down the annulment rate too. Finally, the design of a curer instrument for amblyopia is employed to demonstrate the above viewpoints.

articleTitle: The impact of letters’ relative position on mobile text input performance
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Keypad text input based on thumbs is still the main mobile text input method. So its efficiency is most important to the mobile usability. In the current, most researches on mobile keypad’s ergonomics focus on text input methods, while some scholars improve the efficiency of text input by optimizing the keypad symbols layout However such studies are all about English text input and there are only a few studies on the Chinese text input to the present. Aimed at the deficiency of such studies, the author in the paper made an experiment based on Pinyin text method to discuss if there was difference between performances of two Pinyin letters input in succession under the different relative positions of the buttons. The results showed that the letters’ relative position was one of the factors that influenced the mobile text input performance.

articleTitle: The design of university image and construction of brand strategy
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the market economic development of our country, the image design and brand consciousness comes into all aspects in our life. Nowadays, in the higher education, because it develops rapidly, the universities¿ competitions are intense. University is similar to an enterprise more and more, needs to to carry on the university image design and strengthen the brand construction. It is really important for us to find the development target accurately and take effective measures to portray the brand images.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of interactive virtual industrial product display system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: For the problem of traditional multimedia 3-D industrial products display methods can only realize single-direction playing and don¿t have interactive operation. A way of virtual industrial product display based on virtual reality is put forward. The whole system designed by the combination of software technology such as Java, EAI, SAI and VRML (Virtual Reality Modeling Language). The interactive control of the scene and industrial products are realized by the communications between Java Applet web browser and VRML. The designing of this system have a good effect on the expression of product design and display design in industrial design domain.

articleTitle: The study on the influence of handle shape to the hand based on FEM
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: There is very high impaction to hand when nailing with air nailer. The shape of handle can affect the stress distribution on hand significantly. Hand fatigue and even hurt may be caused if the poor designed tool is used for long time. The 3D model of hand and handle is imported to ANSYS 10.0 to simulate the stress and strain distribution on hand. The shape of the handle is redesigned according to the simulation result. The result shows that the finite element method can be used in the ergonomical evaluation of handle.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Aided Industrial Design system for pneumatic tools
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: There are always some problems existed in traditional product development stage of pneumatic tool such as high cost, low efficiency, long developing period and so on. It can improve developing efficiency by using Computer Aided Industrial Design (CAID) technology in product development. How to use CAID technology in design of pneumatic tool is discussed in this paper. This research proposes Bottom-up design method to support industrial design for pneumatic tool and develops industrial design function system structure. An example of air nailer design is given to explain the function and configuration of ID module including form design, colour design, layout design and ergonomics design, which it can show the whole design process by CAID system.

articleTitle: The application of graphic solution in industrial design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays people begin to apply graphic solution into the industrial design. However, few research works has been carried out, which degrades the effectiveness of graphic solution. Firstly, the paper summarizes the 14 typical diagrams in the fields of commerce and management from the standpoint of general functions of graphic solution, then manages to provide the efficient graphical categories corresponding to each phase in industrial design from the view of information organization and thinking management. At last, we will research the Mind map, which is a kind of efficient graphic solution for assisting innovation.

articleTitle: Evolvable shared mental model for Complex Product collaborative innovative design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Complex product (CoP) innovation is a process of knowledge fusion-oriented collaborative innovative design. In this paper, according to the feature of CoP development, an evolvable shared mental model (ESMM), which is composed of collaborative innovative design process model (DPM), design object model (DOM) based on knowledge ontology and design thinking model (DTM) based on design intention, is proposed. DPM describes the process of collaborative innovative design, DOM describes the explicit knowledge in the design process and DTM describes the tacit knowledge in the design process. Also, the co-evolution method of DOM and the collaborative modeling method of DTM are brought forward, which support explicit knowledge fusion and tacit knowledge fusion of collaborative innovative design separately. Finally, the architecture of CoP collaborative innovative design system based on the ESMM is proposed.

articleTitle: Philosophy of art & arts in philosophy
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Art is concrete, vivid and imagable. it reflects the social ideology. Philosophy is systematical and logical world view. It is a type of science concept as well as being social conscious. Philosophy bases on logical debate. Philosophy and art both belongs to the field of ideology’s presentation appraence, which are relative and evidencial.

articleTitle: A PSD analysis of an online thickness measuring system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: On purpose of analyzing the key-part sensitivity and stability of an online thickness measuring system, the PSD analysis method based on FEM model is used to obtain the displacement, velocity and acceleration response results of the key-part. The analysis results proved that it is effective to use the PSD analysis method on the elastic vibrating part response analysis.

articleTitle: The thinking of traditional art language being applied to innovation design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The confliction and correlation between different cultures can be more intense to arouse people’s desire of passing down tradition from generation to generation than self-continuousness in static state does. The inspiration of different culture systems remind us continuously that when we face the invasion of western modern art and literature trend, our modern innovation design should attach importance to put the connotation of traditional culture into design art language. We should use modern knowledge system to rebuild traditional awareness, to take care and promote traditions, and to create China’s modern design art language.

articleTitle: Research on the hierarchical deconstruction method of product based on the human interface
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The thesis, from the perspective of human cognition, putted forward a new systematical deconstruction method based on the human interface, that is, to deconstruct a product by certain level into the human interface elements( HIEs) and the element logics. Then, on the basis of the kansei engineering technology, it constructed kansei engineering models respectively for the overall HIEs deconstruction pattern and the singular HIE deconstructing pattern, and compares their performances. By comparing the analytical results and validating the tested samples, it pointed out that the overall HIEs pattern, whose kansei engineering model was better at forecasting and illustrating emotions, agrees with human cognitive characteristics, was an effective way to optimize the performance of the kansei engineering model, and will be helpful to the research of kansei engineering.

articleTitle: On the character analysis in the audio-visual language
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Audio-visual language is a language of movie and television. It is not a genuine language since it is composed of lights and sounds, namely audio-visual images instead of words or symbols. However, although it is actually a quasi-language without grammar, it can still be brought under the category of a language because it can convey emotions and meanings just like any language does. Audio-visual language owes its cultural features, artistic quality and ways of communication. As to its cultural features, it is a way of thinking of movies. As to its artistic quality, it is a technique of expression or say, sort of artistic form of movies which is reflected as assumption, uniqueness and montage in movies. As to its ways of communication, it is a system of sign coding for movies reflected as the shots cuts, shots reorganizations and sounds making. As a language too, characters in movies also reflect some ideologies inside. An ideology of the shots is created by the different shooting angels according to the variation of the plots and emotions in the movies. Audio-visual language applied in the creation of characters mainly devotes in the study of the narrative pattern of the shots, namely the way to deal with the relationship of sounds and pictures, the way to connect the shots and the lights and shadows in the whole movement according to our needs. Characters in movies spread information by images instead of languages. We can use the audio-visual language to analyze the variation of the characters in the shots, such as the change between movement and stillness of the characters, the use of music and the mobilization of colors in the creation of characters (We need to study the application of flowing colors in character creation as well since characters in the movies are constantly changing and moving) and the way to embody the effect of lights and shadows combined with the flowing colors. It is known that the essential difference between a cartoon and a movie is its assumption. Cartoon producer is just like the god who creates the world - if you can dream it, you can do it! This paper mainly discusses the character design in cartoons by study every artistic features of the audio-visual language.

articleTitle: A study of ‘hand stitching article’ for animation model design based on ‘pixel art’
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Animation is an inevitable product in the development of the human civilization. Since the computer graphics provides unlimited possibilities for the development of the animation industry and the researches into art forms. As one kind of the digital art, 'pixel art' is an 'extreme' expression form of the bitmap, while the Chinese folk art form, 'hand stitching article', also known as 'Cross-stitched Flower Pattern', mainly using the form of latitude and longitude coordinates to make a 'points' collective creation. Thus it can be seen that 'pixel art' has a very long history and a rather wide spread of range. This paper aims to reference the Chinese folk art form 'hand stitching article', using the 'pixel art' technology to explore the animation modeling performance, eventually to create a global animation modeling image that combines with modern artistic trends and reflects the folk characteristics.

articleTitle: Discussion of another teaching way of teaching design exchange programs between two universities
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Basing on the practice of design teaching exchange programs between two universities, the thesis tries to discuss another design teaching way which focused on the design teaching exchange between universities, and raises its’ purpose, importance, feasibility. Through teaching exchange programs, we can find each part’s strongpoint about the training mode of design education and the student design skills. Moreover, we can find the gaps each other and develop together. Finally, the thesis also discusses the exchange modes of design education.

articleTitle: Body measurement technique based on Chinese characteristic
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This study conducts an anthropometric research project on the 3D head and face shape of Chinese. It aims to create the first-ever digital data on the shapes, capturing vital statistics for design of products such as helmets and spectacles. Measurement data will be collected from the participants all over China, through 3D digital scanning machine of sample populations. The key technique is the extraction of characteristic point from the models and the algorithm to help patch the fragment and merge 3D models with CYBERWARE application more efficiently.

articleTitle: Commercial design must take the social responsibility
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the development of modern society and modern design, the application of commercial design has been very prevalent and active. Nowadays, in the environment of cruel commodity economy and intense market competition, not a few wrong opinions hold that the commercial design only take the responsibility for the design clients and the users of the design products, while not for the society. However, after deep understanding the connotation of the commercial design and the social responsibility, and correct recognizing the dual attributes of the design products users as human being, it is clear that the commercial design must take the social responsibility. Only in this way, can commercial design serve the modern society and market better; can commercial design get the healthy development of itself, and become more splendid.

articleTitle: The ethical meaning of design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Studied from the extensive range ethics, to consider the problem of design abroad from the angle of the ontology of aspect, the ontology of the design is the self-reflection on the existence of design itself, it¿s also the apperception and the explanation about the value and the meaning of design. The article tries to explain a series of problems from the angle of culture and philosophy, including definition, function, innovation and ethical values. The article focuses on cultural research and philosophical criticism of the design activity thoroughly and intensively, which is also the springboard and thinking foundation of the article.

articleTitle: The Design of traditional artifacts culture & geographical features
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: From the geographical point of culture, the thesis illustrates the relationship between creator design activities and Specific geographical conditions, which are related to cultural artifacts technical level. Meanwhile, discussing the important significance of geographical design which is based on chinese national conditions, and finding several new methods and proposed a regional entry points. Geographical design is one of the main design methods in the future which is related to the social, natural and harmonious development.

articleTitle: Application of maximum entropy method in Chinese-English cross language information retrieval
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In cross language information retrieval, such as Chinese-English information retrieval, the query sentence often comprises some query keywords, but not a complete sentence. Because of the lack of necessary context and syntactic information in the query keywords, it is difficult to translate the query sentence accurately and return the results which are the best fit to the query. So, in Chinese-English cross language information retrieval, how to obtain effective Web pages and evaluate translation candidates are two challenging issues. In this paper, an approach based maximum entropy method (MEM) is proposed to obtain effective Web pages. For obtaining a correct translation list, we establish English-Chinese, Chinese - English special dictionary. Thus we can translate the query as accurately as possible by using bi-directional translation with disambiguation based on MEM. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method has a good performance in Chinese-English cross language information retrieval, and achieves 86.8% accuracy.

articleTitle: The aesthetic connotations of the marble-inlay in the Qing-style furniture
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The article expatiates the use of marble has influenced the aesthetic characters of the Qing-style furniture through appreciation and aesthetic analysis of the marble-inlaid Qing-style furniture. Its aesthetic idiosyncrasies combi ned with Taoist inherency and abstract art in which literati reposed their life ideals have, to a certain degree, brought about the transcendence of reality, the weakening of ideological utilitarian purposes and the retainment of pure aesthetic orientation.

articleTitle: Research of virtual driving safety warning system based on OpenGVS
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The virtual driving safety warning system is employed to remind the driver of dangerous operations in virtual driving, which can help to form good habit in real driving. The system can be divided into the hardware and software system. The hardware system is used for collecting, processing and transferring the driving operations from the driver. And the software platform is constructed by Visual C++ 6.0 and OpenGVS. According to the driving signals collected by the hardware system, the software system changes the status of the virtual vehicle with these signals. And the status of the other objects in the virtual scene, such as virtual road, obstacles and the other virtual vehicles, is also analyzed. The result of the analysis will determine whether gives a warning to the driver or not. The warning includes road departure warning, safe distance warning, and obstacle warning, etc. If the warning varies, the warning device sends different warning signals to the driver. And the warning history is recorded by the software system automatically. The data transfer in the system is realized by the serial communication procedure, the implementation of which is discussed in the software system. The research results of the paper have been applied in the virtual driving application, and get good effects.

articleTitle: A study on the “Hollow Design” of Chinese bamboo product
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the analysis on hundreds of collected bamboo products in China, this paper summarizes six basic functions of bamboo products, discussing these functions embody hollow character in some way because of the hollow affordance of bamboo itself. Furthermore, this study brings up a new concept “Hollow Design”, pointing out that the hollow character of bamboo is the origin of the “Hollow Design”. Then, this paper finds two design modes of “Hollow Design” which are based on horizontal cutting and vertical cutting of bamboo culms, the hole produced by these two design modes is the key factor and higher development of “Hollow Design”, four sorts of holes are discussed. Finally, three advantages of “Hollow Design” are pointed out: “Hollow Design” explores the hollow affordance of bamboo fully; uses the simplest form to finish the most suitable function; provides a new idea for product design, not only for bamboo product design itself.

articleTitle: An explore study on reform of teaching professional color design for industrial design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the current situation of elementary color education for industrial design, the authors review the problems in current professional color education. According to the actual needs of color design for products, original ideas about teaching reform are brought up in the paper.

articleTitle: A tolerance representation model for conceptual design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Conceptual design is crucial in new product development with great impact on the downstream design process. However, current engineering practices often involve tolerancing in the detail design phase not in the conceptual design phase. This paper presents a methodology where the design tolerancing is considered in the conceptual design phase to ensure the feasibility of conceptual-structure design. The essence of tolerance design is the conversion of product functional requirements to functional tolerances. The characteristic and mating surfaces called key features (KFs) with profound influences on the product requirements are developed. Then the ATTRIB class offered by ACIS geometrical kernel is used to establish the hierarchical structure of all the necessary tolerance classes. The hierarchical tolerance representation model is constructed based on the Topologically and Technologically Related Surfaces (FTTRS). Therefore, the entire framework of the functional tolerance design is developed. The conceptual design-oriented tolerance information model effectively integrates the tolerance design and conceptual design.

articleTitle: Research and realization of network management platform based on MDA
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Model Driven Architecture (MDA) is a new approach to construct enterprise applications. It believes that the best way for system development is to insulate the design and the realization of system, to model business behavior and domain elements independently; thereby model construction is the key of MDA. At the same time, Object Management Group (OMG) put forward a series of criterions, such as MOF, UML, and QVT. In this article we abstract the domain model of telecoms based on these criterions, reuse the presentation component of telecommunications, meantime the domain model will be mapped to the presentation component, and finally we develop network management system by combination of components. We will give an example to explain how to develop network management system of telecommunications by this way in detail.

articleTitle: Research on logistic information system based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: RFID can automatically identify multi-target and moving target in non-contact method. Internet of things, based on RFID, emphasizes the interaction between material and information, can improve the service level of the industry by using RFID technology in data collection and material tracing. Logistic management of raw material is a set of complex procedures. And this project aims to increase the raw material quality, applies RFID technology to manufacturing logistic management, and presents a RFID-based material tracking information system, so as to make the raw material able to be traced and tracked automatically and improve the semi-product or product quality by optimizing the procedure of raw material management. In this paper, according to the practical producing procedures and the demand of products quality of a company, a material tracking information system which combines RFID technology, computer networks and database technology is designed, and the design includes system architecture, RFID data acquisition method, database accessing interface, backend database and part client user software. Integrating RFID into material tracking information system guarantees product quality.

articleTitle: The combination of Chinese and Japanese culture in Japanese package design
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In less than fifty years, Japanese modern package design has reached the high level which has taken the western countries almost one hundred years. The main reason for its success is that Japanese package design is deeply rooted in its own national and traditional cultures, at the same time unceasingly absorbs the beneficial elements from the foreign cultures, especially Chinese culture. In this paper, authors explore how Japanese culture is strongly influenced by Chinese influence in different aspects and then focus on the combination of Chinese and Japanese culture in Japanese package design.
